287: async def execute_run(context: RunContext, is_new_conversation: bool) -> None:
288:     """后台运行：独立于 SSE 连接，客户端断开不影响执行。"""
289:     settings = get_settings()
290:     run_id = context.run_id
291:     publisher = context.publisher
292:     started_wall = _now()
293:     started_at: datetime | None = None
294:     first_token_ms: int | None = None
295:     content_parts: list[str] = []
296:     reasoning_parts: list[str] = []
297:     reasoning_started: datetime | None = None
298:     usage: dict[str, Any] = {}
299: 
300:     try:
301:         async with get_session_factory()() as db:
302:             run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
303:             if run is None:
304:                 return
305:             if run.status != "running":
306:                 # 取消可能发生在后台任务真正开始之前；补一个终态事件让 SSE 正常结束。
307:                 if run.status == "canceled" and not context.terminal_emitted:
308:                     context.terminal_emitted = True
309:                     # 任务还没开始就被取消：补记助手消息计数，保证会话统计与消息行一致。
310:                     conversation = await db.get(Conversation, run.conversation_id)
311:                     if conversation is not None:
312:                         conversation.message_count += 1
313:                         conversation.last_message_at = _now()
314:                         conversation.last_message_preview = "（已取消）"
315:                         await db.commit()
316:                     await publisher.emit(
317:                         "message.done",
318:                         {
319:                             "message_id": (
320:                                 str(run.assistant_message_id) if run.assistant_message_id else ""
321:                             ),
322:                             "usage": _usage_dict(None),
323:                             "finish_reason": "canceled",
324:                             "model": run.model,
325:                             "first_token_ms": None,
326:                             "duration_ms": 0,
327:                             "active_duration_ms": 0,
328:                             "citations": [],
329:                             "artifacts": [],
330:                         },
331:                         event_type="message",
332:                         status="canceled",
333:                         title="已取消",
334:                     )
335:                 return
336:             conversation = await db.get(Conversation, run.conversation_id)
337:             user_message = (
338:                 await db.get(Message, run.user_message_id) if run.user_message_id else None
339:             )
340:             assistant_message = (
341:                 await db.get(Message, run.assistant_message_id)
342:                 if run.assistant_message_id
343:                 else None
344:             )
345:             if conversation is None or user_message is None or assistant_message is None:
346:                 _raise_missing_run_data()
347:             started_at = run.started_at or started_wall
348:             conversation_id = conversation.id
349:             conversation_title = conversation.title
350:             user_message_id = user_message.id
351:             assistant_message_id = assistant_message.id
352:             user_message_created = user_message.created_at
353:             user_text = user_message.content
354:             client_message_id = user_message.client_message_id or ""
355:             requested_effort = run.reasoning_effort or "low"
356:             model_name = run.model
357: 
358:         if is_new_conversation:
359:             await publisher.emit(
360:                 "conversation.created",
361:                 {"conversation_id": str(conversation_id), "title": conversation_title},
362:                 event_type="message",
363:                 title="创建会话",
364:             )
365:         await publisher.emit(
366:             "run.started",
367:             {
368:                 "conversation_id": str(conversation_id),
369:                 "user_message_id": str(user_message_id),
370:                 "client_message_id": client_message_id,
371:                 "model": model_name,
372:                 "reasoning_effort": requested_effort,
373:                 "workflow_id": None,
374:                 "workflow_version": None,
375:             },
376:             event_type="request",
377:             title="用户请求",
378:             subtitle=user_text[:80],
379:         )
380:         await publisher.emit(
381:             "message.created",
382:             {
383:                 "message_id": str(user_message_id),
384:                 "role": "user",
385:                 "client_message_id": client_message_id,
386:                 "created_at": to_iso(user_message_created),
387:             },
388:             event_type="message",
389:             title="用户消息",
390:             subtitle=user_text[:80],
391:         )
392:         await publisher.emit(
393:             "message.started",
394:             {
395:                 "message_id": str(assistant_message_id),
396:                 "role": "assistant",
397:                 "started_at": to_iso(_now()),
398:             },
399:             event_type="message",
400:             status="running",
401:             title="助手消息",
402:         )
403: 
404:         model = build_chat_model(settings)
405:         async with open_checkpointer() as saver:
406:             graph = build_graph(model, saver)
407:             config = {"configurable": {"thread_id": str(conversation_id)}}
408:             async for chunk, metadata in graph.astream(
409:                 {"messages": [HumanMessage(content=user_text)]},
410:                 config,
411:                 stream_mode="messages",
412:             ):
413:                 if context.cancel_requested:
414:                     raise asyncio.CancelledError  # noqa: TRY301 - 取消信号需要冒泡到外层
415:                 if metadata.get("langgraph_node") != "model":
416:                     continue
417:                 if not isinstance(chunk, AIMessageChunk):
418:                     continue
419: 
420:                 reasoning = chunk.additional_kwargs.get("reasoning_content")
421:                 if isinstance(reasoning, str) and reasoning:
422:                     if reasoning_started is None:
423:                         reasoning_started = _now()
424:                     reasoning_parts.append(reasoning)
425:                     await publisher.emit(
426:                         "reasoning.delta",
427:                         {"message_id": str(assistant_message_id), "delta": reasoning},
428:                         persist=False,
429:                     )
430: 
431:                 text = _content_text(chunk.content)
432:                 if text:
433:                     if first_token_ms is None:
434:                         first_token_ms = int((_now() - started_at).total_seconds() * 1000)
435:                     content_parts.append(text)
436:                     await publisher.emit(
437:                         "message.delta",
438:                         {"message_id": str(assistant_message_id), "delta": text},
439:                         persist=False,
440:                     )
441:                 if chunk.usage_metadata:
442:                     usage = dict(chunk.usage_metadata)
443: 
444:             snapshot = await graph.aget_state(config)
445:             messages = snapshot.values.get("messages", [])
446:             if messages:
447:                 final_message = messages[-1]
448:                 final_text = _content_text(getattr(final_message, "content", ""))
449:                 if final_text and not content_parts:
450:                     content_parts.append(final_text)
451:                 if getattr(final_message, "usage_metadata", None):
452:                     usage = dict(final_message.usage_metadata)
453: 
454:         now = _now()
455:         duration_ms = int((now - started_at).total_seconds() * 1000)
456:         notes = _usage_dict(usage)
457:         content = "".join(content_parts)
458: 
459:         if reasoning_parts:
460:             reasoning_text = "".join(reasoning_parts)
461:             await publisher.emit(
462:                 "reasoning.done",
463:                 {
464:                     "message_id": str(assistant_message_id),
465:                     "duration_ms": int(
466:                         ((_now() - (reasoning_started or started_at)).total_seconds()) * 1000
467:                     ),
468:                     "tokens": notes["reasoning_tokens"],
469:                     "summary": reasoning_text[:2000],
470:                 },
471:                 event_type="message",
472:                 title="思考摘要",
473:             )
474: 
475:         completed = await _finalize_success(
476:             run_id=run_id,
477:             assistant_message_id=assistant_message_id,
478:             content=content,
479:             usage=notes,
480:             first_token_ms=first_token_ms,
481:             duration_ms=duration_ms,
482:             finished_at=now,
483:         )
484:         if not completed:
485:             await asyncio.shield(
486:                 _finalize_canceled(
487:                     context=context,
488:                     content=content,
489:                     usage=notes,
490:                     first_token_ms=first_token_ms,
491:                     started_at=started_at or started_wall,
492:                 )
493:             )
494:             return
495:         if context.terminal_emitted:
496:             return
497:         context.terminal_emitted = True
498:         await publisher.emit(
499:             "message.done",
500:             {
501:                 "conversation_id": str(conversation_id),
502:                 "message_id": str(assistant_message_id),
503:                 "usage": notes,
504:                 "finish_reason": "stop",
505:                 "model": model_name,
506:                 "first_token_ms": first_token_ms,
507:                 "duration_ms": duration_ms,
508:                 "active_duration_ms": duration_ms,
509:                 "citations": [],
510:                 "artifacts": [],
511:                 "reasoning": (
512:                     {
513:                         "duration_ms": int(
514:                             ((_now() - (reasoning_started or started_at)).total_seconds()) * 1000
515:                         ),
516:                         "tokens": notes["reasoning_tokens"],
517:                         "summary": "".join(reasoning_parts)[:2000],
518:                     }
519:                     if reasoning_parts
520:                     else None
521:                 ),
522:             },

30:         self._contexts[context.run_id] = context

33:         context.task = asyncio.create_task(coroutine, name=f"run-{context.run_id}")
34:         self._contexts[context.run_id] = context
35:         context.task.add_done_callback(lambda _: self._contexts.pop(context.run_id, None))
36:

41:         context = self._contexts.get(run_id)
42:         return bool(context and context.task and not context.task.done())
43: 
44:     def cancel(self, run_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
45:         context = self._contexts.get(run_id)
46:         if context is None or context.task is None or context.task.done():
47:             return False
48:         context.cancel_requested = True
49:         context.task.cancel()
50:         return True
51:

53:         tasks = [
54:             context.task
55:             for context in self._contexts.values()
56:             if context.task is not None and not context.task.done()
57:         ]
58:         for task in tasks:
59:             task.cancel()
60:         if tasks:
61:             await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
62:         self._contexts.clear()

54:         event: str,

64:         error: dict[str, Any] | None = None,

70:             "ts": to_iso(ts),
71:             "seq": self.seq,
72:             **data,
73:         }

# 业务模块约定

`app/modules/` 按业务能力分包，每个模块自成闭环；模块之间只通过 service 层或 `app/core/deps.py` 暴露的依赖交互，禁止跨模块直接 import 对方的 `router`。

## 模块清单

| 模块 | 职责 | 规划文件 |
|---|---|---|
| `auth/` | 注册、登录、刷新令牌、当前用户、JWT 鉴权依赖 | `schemas.py` `repo.py` `service.py` `router.py` |
| `conversations/` | 会话创建/列表/重命名/归档/删除、消息历史分页 | `schemas.py` `repo.py` `service.py` `router.py` |
| `chat/` | 用户消息 → LangGraph → SSE 流式；运行取消；中断恢复 | `schemas.py` `service.py` `router.py` |
| `agents/` | 远程智能体注册、Agent Card 拉取与缓存、健康检查、能力目录 | `schemas.py` `repo.py` `service.py` `router.py` |
| `a2a/` | A2A 服务端（AgentExecutor）与客户端封装、LangChain 工具桥接 | `card.py` `executor.py` `server.py` `client.py` `tool.py` `registry.py` |
| `knowledge/` | 知识库文档上传、解析、切分、Embedding、重建索引、检索接口 | `schemas.py` `repo.py` `service.py` `router.py` |
| `tasks/` | run 与 A2A Task 的查询、取消、事件回放 | `schemas.py` `repo.py` `service.py` `router.py` |
| `approvals/` | 高风险工具/远程调用的人工审批（HITL） | `schemas.py` `repo.py` `service.py` `router.py` |
| `mcp/` | MCP 服务器注册、连接与工具发现、工具桥接、健康检查 | `schemas.py` `repo.py` `service.py` `router.py` `client.py` `tool.py` |
| `skills/` | 本地技能包导入、校验、存储、激活与参考文件读取 | `schemas.py` `repo.py` `service.py` `router.py` `importer.py` |
| `memories/` | 长期记忆的保存策略、检索注入、管理接口 | `schemas.py` `service.py` `router.py` |
| `instructions/` | 平台默认/用户覆盖解析、生效预览、审计 | `schemas.py` `repo.py` `service.py` `router.py` |

## 文件分层

```
router.py     HTTP 边界：参数解析、鉴权依赖、调用 service、返回 DTO
schemas.py    Pydantic 请求/响应模型，不复用 ORM 模型
service.py    业务规则与事务边界；不依赖 FastAPI Request/Response
repo.py       纯持久化操作；复杂查询放这里，SQL 不散落在 service
```

- **ORM 模型不放在模块内**：统一放 `app/db/models/<领域>.py`，由 `app/db/models/__init__.py` 汇总导入，保证 Alembic 能发现。
- **repo 可省略**：纯 CRUD 且没有复杂查询时，service 可直接用 `AsyncSession`；一旦出现跨表查询/锁/批量操作，再补 repo。
- **依赖注入**：数据库会话用 `app.db.session.get_db`；当前用户用 `app.core.deps.get_current_user`（待实现）。

## 依赖方向

```
router → service → repo → db.models
router → schemas
service → schemas（类型化输入输出）
modules/a2a → agents（LangGraph 图与工具）
modules/chat → agents（图执行）
modules/chat → modules/{instructions,memories,skills,mcp}（能力目录装配）
modules/mcp → agents（MCP 工具定义）
modules/skills → agents（技能正文注入）
```

禁止反向依赖：`agents/` 不 import `modules/`；`db/` 不 import `modules/`。

1: """审批查询与决定。
2: 
3: M1 只有数据模型与接口；能触发 interrupt 的工具在 M2/M5 接入，

7: from __future__ import annotations
8:

14:

17:     ApprovalAlreadyDecidedError,
18:     ApprovalExpiredError,
19:     NotFoundError,

21: )

28:     ApprovalDeciderOut,
29:     ApprovalDecisionRequest,
30:     ApprovalDecisionResult,
31:     ApprovalOut,
32:     ApprovalPage,
33: )
34: 
35: _STATUSES = ("pending", "approved", "rejected", "expired", "canceled")
36: 
37: 
38: def _now() -> datetime:
39:     return datetime.now(UTC)
40: 
41: 
42: def _approval_out(
43:     approval: Approval,
44:     conversation: Conversation,
45:     decider: User | None,
46: ) -> ApprovalOut:
47:     return ApprovalOut(
48:         id=approval.id,
49:         run_id=approval.run_id,
50:         conversation_id=conversation.id,
51:         conversation_title=conversation.title,
52:         status=approval.status,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
53:         tool_name=approval.tool_name,
54:         tool_display_name=approval.tool_display_name,
55:         source=approval.source,
56:         executor=approval.executor,
57:         target=approval.target,
58:         side_effect=approval.side_effect,
59:         risk=approval.risk,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
60:         reason=approval.reason,
61:         payload=approval.payload or {},
62:         payload_preview=approval.payload_preview,
63:         expires_at=approval.expires_at,
64:         created_at=approval.created_at,
65:         decided_at=approval.decided_at,
66:         decided_by=(
67:             ApprovalDeciderOut(id=decider.id, display_name=decider.display_name)
68:             if decider
69:             else None
70:         ),
71:         decision_note=approval.decision_note,
72:     )
73:

75: def _base_query():
76:     return (
77:         select(Approval, Conversation, User)
78:         .join(Run, Approval.run_id == Run.id)
79:         .join(Conversation, Run.conversation_id == Conversation.id)
80:         .outerjoin(User, Approval.decided_by == User.id)
81:     )

84: async def list_approvals(
85:     db: AsyncSession,
86:     user: User,
87:     *,
88:     status: str,
89:     conversation_id: uuid.UUID | None,
90:     run_id: uuid.UUID | None,
91:     limit: int,
92:     cursor: str | None,
93: ) -> ApprovalPage:
94:     stmt = _base_query().where(Conversation.user_id == user.id)
95:     if status in _STATUSES:
96:         stmt = stmt.where(Approval.status == status)
97:     if conversation_id is not None:
98:         stmt = stmt.where(Run.conversation_id == conversation_id)
99:     if run_id is not None:
100:         stmt = stmt.where(Approval.run_id == run_id)
101:     cursor_data = decode_cursor(cursor)
102:     if cursor_data:
103:         raw_time = cursor_data.get("t")
104:         raw_id = cursor_data.get("id")
105:         try:
106:             last_time = datetime.fromisoformat(raw_time) if raw_time else None
107:             last_id = uuid.UUID(str(raw_id)) if raw_id else None
108:         except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
109:             raise ValidationFailedError("分页游标无效") from exc
110:         if last_time is None or last_id is None:
111:             raise ValidationFailedError("分页游标无效")
112:         stmt = stmt.where(
113:             or_(
114:                 Approval.created_at < last_time,
115:                 and_(Approval.created_at == last_time, Approval.id < last_id),
116:             )
117:         )
118:     stmt = stmt.order_by(Approval.created_at.desc(), Approval.id.desc()).limit(limit + 1)
119:     rows = (await db.execute(stmt)).all()
120:     has_more = len(rows) > limit
121:     rows = rows[:limit]
122:     items = [
123:         _approval_out(row[0], row[1], row[2] if isinstance(row[2], User) else None) for row in rows
124:     ]
125:     next_cursor = None
126:     if has_more and rows:
127:         last = rows[-1][0]
128:         next_cursor = encode_cursor({"t": last.created_at.isoformat(), "id": last.id})
129: 
130:     stats_rows = (
131:         await db.execute(
132:             select(Approval.status, func.count(Approval.id))
133:             .join(Run, Approval.run_id == Run.id)
134:             .join(Conversation, Run.conversation_id == Conversation.id)
135:             .where(Conversation.user_id == user.id)
136:             .group_by(Approval.status)
137:         )
138:     ).all()
139:     stats = {key: 0 for key in _STATUSES}
140:     for key, count in stats_rows:
141:         if key in stats:
142:             stats[key] = int(count)
143:     return ApprovalPage(items=items, next_cursor=next_cursor, has_more=has_more, stats=stats)
144: 
145: 
146: async def get_approval(db: AsyncSession, user: User, approval_id: uuid.UUID) -> ApprovalOut:
147:     row = (
148:         await db.execute(
149:             _base_query().where(Approval.id == approval_id, Conversation.user_id == user.id)
150:         )
151:     ).first()
152:     if row is None:
153:         raise NotFoundError("审批不存在")
154:     return _approval_out(row[0], row[1], row[2] if isinstance(row[2], User) else None)
155: 
156: 
157: async def decide(
158:     db: AsyncSession,
159:     user: User,
160:     approval_id: uuid.UUID,
161:     payload: ApprovalDecisionRequest,
162: ) -> ApprovalDecisionResult:
163:     row = (
164:         await db.execute(
165:             select(Approval)
166:             .join(Run, Approval.run_id == Run.id)
167:             .join(Conversation, Run.conversation_id == Conversation.id)
168:             .where(Approval.id == approval_id, Conversation.user_id == user.id)
169:             .with_for_update()
170:         )
171:     ).scalar_one_or_none()
172:     if row is None:
173:         raise NotFoundError("审批不存在")
174:     approval = row
175:     now = _now()
176:     if approval.status == "pending" and approval.expires_at and approval.expires_at <= now:
177:         approval.status = "expired"
178:         await db.commit()
179:         raise ApprovalExpiredError("审批已过期")
180:     if approval.status != "pending":
181:         if approval.status == "expired":
182:             raise ApprovalExpiredError("审批已过期")
183:         raise ApprovalAlreadyDecidedError("审批已处理，请刷新状态")
184: 
185:     approval.status = "approved" if payload.decision == "approve" else "rejected"
186:     approval.decided_by = user.id
187:     approval.decided_at = now
188:     approval.decision_note = payload.note
189:     run = await db.get(Run, approval.run_id)
190:     resumed = False
191:     resume_error: str | None = None
192:     if payload.decision == "approve":
193:         if run is not None and run.status == "interrupted":
194:             resume_error = "当前版本尚未接入可恢复工具，请在 M2 后重试"
195:         else:
196:             resume_error = "运行不处于等待审批状态"
197:     await db.commit()
198:     return ApprovalDecisionResult(
199:         id=approval.id,
200:         status=approval.status,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
201:         run_id=approval.run_id,
202:         resumed=resumed,
203:         resume_error=resume_error,
204:     )

208:     """后台巡检：把超时未处理的审批置为 expired。"""

211:         ids = list(
212:             (

215:                     .where(

217:                         Approval.expires_at.is_not(None),
218:                         Approval.expires_at <= now,
219:                     )
220:                     .limit(limit)
221:                 )
222:             ).scalars()
223:         )
224:         if not ids:
225:             return 0
226:         await db.execute(update(Approval).where(Approval.id.in_(ids)).values(status="expired"))
227:         await db.commit()
228:         return len(ids)

42: 
43:     status_code: int = 400

58:         if status_code is not None:
59:             self.status_code = status_code

69:         # 需要携带 run_id 等结构化信息时放在 details 里，避免破坏信封形状。
70:         if self.details:

10: import re
11: from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
12: from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

14: from langgraph.checkpoint.base import BaseCheckpointSaver

18:

25: _memory_saver: InMemorySaver | None = None
26: 
27: 
28: def _validate_schema(schema: str) -> str:
29:     if not _SCHEMA_PATTERN.match(schema):
30:         raise RuntimeError(f"非法 checkpoint schema：{schema}")
31:     return schema
32: 
33: 
34: def _get_memory_saver() -> InMemorySaver:
35:     global _memory_saver
36:     if _memory_saver is None:
37:         _memory_saver = InMemorySaver()
38:     return _memory_saver
39: 
40: 
41: def reset_memory_checkpointer() -> None:
42:     """测试辅助：清空内存 checkpoint，避免用例互相影响。"""
43:     global _memory_saver
44:     _memory_saver = InMemorySaver()

49:         return

"""Alembic 异步环境。

连接串从 ``Settings`` 读取，不在 alembic.ini 写死；
所有模型通过 ``app.db.models`` 汇总导入，保证 autogenerate 可见。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
from logging.config import fileConfig

from sqlalchemy import pool
from sqlalchemy.engine import Connection
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import async_engine_from_config

from alembic import context
from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.db import models  # noqa: F401  # 导入以注册全部模型
from app.db.base import Base

config = context.config
if config.config_file_name is not None:
    fileConfig(config.config_file_name)

config.set_main_option("sqlalchemy.url", get_settings().database_url)
target_metadata = Base.metadata


def run_migrations_offline() -> None:
    context.configure(
        url=config.get_main_option("sqlalchemy.url"),
        target_metadata=target_metadata,
        literal_binds=True,
        dialect_opts={"paramstyle": "named"},
        compare_type=True,
    )
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


def do_run_migrations(connection: Connection) -> None:
    context.configure(
        connection=connection,
        target_metadata=target_metadata,
        compare_type=True,
        compare_server_default=True,
    )
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


async def run_async_migrations() -> None:
    connectable = async_engine_from_config(
        config.get_section(config.config_ini_section, {}),
        prefix="sqlalchemy.",
        poolclass=pool.NullPool,
    )
    async with connectable.connect() as connection:
        await connection.run_sync(do_run_migrations)
    await connectable.dispose()

"""导出 OpenAPI 契约到 docs/openapi.json，供前端生成类型/核对契约。

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

# 直接以 ``python scripts/export_openapi.py`` 运行时，sys.path[0] 是 scripts/，
# 需要显式补上项目根，否则 ``import app`` 失败。
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from app.main import app


def main() -> None:
    target = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "docs" / "openapi.json"
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_text(
        json.dumps(app.openapi(), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )

- id UUID PK
- scope String(16) check system|user
- owner_user_id FK users CASCADE nullable
- slug String(64)
- name String(128)
- description Text
- content Text
- version String(32) default '1.0'
- metadata_ JSONB '{}'
- source String(16) check builtin|upload|manual

- force_disabled bool default false

- size_bytes Integer default 0

- content Text
- size_bytes Integer
- created_at

- Checks: scope='user' OR owner_user_id IS NULL; (transport='stdio' AND command IS NOT NULL) OR (transport<>'stdio' AND url IS NOT NULL)

- exposed_name String(64)

- requires_approval bool default true
- admin_only bool default false
- user_allowed bool default true
- enabled bool default true
- discovered_at DateTime
- updated_at
- Unique (server_id, name); index (server_id, enabled)

- user_id FK users CASCADE
- capability String(16) check mcp_server|skill
- target_id UUID (no FK)
- enabled bool
- created_at/updated_at
- PK (user_id, capability, target_id)

- kind String(16) check profile|preference|fact
- title String(200) ''
- content Text
- source JSONB '{}'

- status String(16) check active|archived default active

- id BigInteger Identity PK

- status String(16) check pending|ok|error|rejected|canceled
- args JSONB '{}'
- result JSONB nullable
- duration_ms Integer nullable
- error String(512) nullable / Text? design says脱敏截断 → String(512)
- created_at, finished_at nullable
- Index (source, created_at DESC), (run_id, created_at)

For tests with mock servers I'll use a host like "mcp.example.com" which won't resolve... socket.getaddrinfo on a non-resolving domain returns error → blocked! That breaks create-server tests unless the host is in the allowlist. Solution: tests set MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS=mcp.example.com,localhost in env, or use `example.com` which... getaddrinfo("example.com") may fail offline. So tests must set MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS to include the mock host. I'll set conftest env: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS="mcp.example.com,mcp.test,127.0.0.1,localhost". I'll do: check messages where attachments JSONB contains str(id); if referenced → soft delete; else physical delete. Report documents.
- download_attachment: owner, status ready (deleted → 404), file exists → FileResponse with Content-Disposition attachment; filename*=UTF-8.

- DELETE /attachments/{id}
- GET /attachments/{id}/download

{"content": """"附件业务：上传（sha256 去重）、列表、详情、删除与受控下载。"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import logging
import shutil
import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import UploadFile
from sqlalchemy import and_, func, or_, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.audit import write_audit
from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.core.cursor import decode_cursor, encode_cursor
from app.core.errors import (
    CapabilityDisabledError,
    NotFoundError,
    PayloadTooLargeError,
    ValidationFailedError,
)
from app.db.models.attachment import Attachment
from app.db.models.conversation import Conversation, Message
from app.db.models.user import User
from app.modules.attachments.schemas import AttachmentOut, AttachmentPage

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# 可以被解码注入模型上下文的文本类型（其余只发快照）。
_TEXT_MIME_PREFIXES = ("text/", "application/json", "application/xml", "application/x-yaml")


def _now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _attachment_out(attachment: Attachment, *, duplicate: bool = False) -> AttachmentOut:
    return AttachmentOut(
        id=attachment.id,
        filename=attachment.filename,
        mime_type=attachment.mime_type,
        size_bytes=attachment.size_bytes,
        checksum=attachment.checksum,
        status=attachment.status,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        purpose=attachment.purpose,
        conversation_id=attachment.conversation_id,
        created_at=attachment.created_at,
        expires_at=attachment.expires_at,
        duplicate=duplicate,
    )


def _storage_dir(settings, user_id: uuid.UUID) -> Path:
    path = Path(settings.attachment_dir) / str(user_id)
    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return path


def _extract_text(mime_type: str, raw: bytes, max_chars: int) -> str | None:
    if not mime_type.startswith(_TEXT_MIME_PREFIXES):
        return None
    if len(raw) > 4 * 1024 * 1024:
        # 大文本不逐字解码（超长文本可能不是有效 UTF-8，也避免内存放大）。
        return raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")[:max_chars]
    return raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")[:max_chars]


async def create_attachment(
    db: AsyncSession,
    user: User,
    file: UploadFile,
    *,
    conversation_id: uuid.UUID | None,
    purpose: str,
) -> AttachmentOut:
    settings = get_settings()
    if not settings.attachments_enabled:
        raise CapabilityDisabledError("附件能力未启用")
    filename = (file.filename or "unnamed").strip()
    if not filename or len(filename) > 255:
        raise ValidationFailedError("文件名不合法")
    mime_type = (file.content_type or "application/octet-stream").split(";")[0].strip().lower()
    if mime_type not in settings.allowed_mime_type_list:
        raise ValidationFailedError(
            f"不支持的文件类型：{mime_type}", code="attachment_type_not_allowed"
        )
    if conversation_id is not None:
        conversation = await db.scalar(
            select(Conversation).where(
                Conversation.id == conversation_id,
                Conversation.user_id == user.id,
                Conversation.status != "deleted",
            )
        )
        if conversation is None:
            raise NotFoundError("会话不存在")

    raw = await file.read(settings.attachment_max_bytes + 1)
    if len(raw) > settings.attachment_max_bytes:
        raise PayloadTooLargeError(
            f"文件超过 {settings.attachment_max_bytes // (1024 * 1024)}MB 上限"
        )
    checksum = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

    # 同用户 + 同 checksum 去重：直接复用已有记录，不重复落盘。
    existing = await db.scalar(
        select(Attachment)
        .where(
            Attachment.user_id == user.id,
            Attachment.checksum == checksum,
            Attachment.status != "deleted",
        )
        .order_by(Attachment.created_at.desc())
        .limit(1)
    )
    if existing is not None:
        await write_audit(
            db,
            actor_type="user",
            actor_id=str(user.id),
            action="attachment.upload_deduplicated",
            resource_type="attachment",
            resource_id=str(existing.id),
            detail={"filename": filename[:200], "size": len(raw)},
        )
        await db.commit()
        return _attachment_out(existing, duplicate=True)

    attachment = Attachment(
        user_id=user.id,
        conversation_id=conversation_id,
        filename=filename,
        mime_type=mime_type,
        size_bytes=len(raw),
        checksum=checksum,
        status="processing",
        purpose=purpose,
        text_excerpt=_extract_text(mime_type, raw, settings.attachment_text_max_chars),
        expires_at=_now() + timedelta(hours=settings.attachment_retention_hours),
    )
    db.add(attachment)
    await db.flush()

    path = _storage_dir(settings, user.id) / f"{attachment.id}-{filename}"
    try:
        await _write_file(path, raw)
    except OSError:
        attachment.status = "failed"
        await db.commit()
        logger.exception("附件写盘失败 attachment_id=%s", attachment.id)
        raise
    attachment.storage_path = str(path)
    attachment.status = "ready"
    await write_audit(
        db,
        actor_type="user",
        actor_id=str(user.id),
        action="attachment.upload",
        resource_type="attachment",
        resource_id=str(attachment.id),
        detail={"filename": filename[:200], "size": len(raw), "checksum": checksum[:16]},
    )
    await db.commit()
    return _attachment_out(attachment)


async def _write_file(path: Path, raw: bytes) -> None:
    tmp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    tmp.write_bytes(raw)
    tmp.replace(path)


async def list_attachments(
    db: AsyncSession,
    user: User,
    *,
    conversation_id: uuid.UUID | None,
    limit: int,
    cursor: str | None,
) -> AttachmentPage:
    stmt = select(Attachment).where(
        Attachment.user_id == user.id, Attachment.status != "deleted"
    )
    if conversation_id is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(Attachment.conversation_id == conversation_id)
    cursor_data = decode_cursor(cursor)
    if cursor_data:
        raw_time = cursor_data.get("t")
        raw_id = cursor_data.get("id")
        try:
            last_time = datetime.fromisoformat(raw_time) if raw_time else None
            last_id = uuid.UUID(str(raw_id)) if raw_id else None
        except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
            raise ValidationFailedError("分页游标无效") from exc
        if last_time is None or last_id is None:
            raise ValidationFailedError("分页游标无效")
        stmt = stmt.where(
            or_(
                Attachment.created_at < last_time,
                and_(Attachment.created_at == last_time, Attachment.id < last_id),
            )
        )
    stmt = stmt.order_by(Attachment.created_at.desc(), Attachment.id.desc()).limit(limit + 1)
    rows = list((await db.execute(stmt)).scalars().all())
    has_more = len(rows) > limit
    rows = rows[:limit]
    next_cursor = None
    if has_more and rows:
        next_cursor = encode_cursor({"t": rows[-1].created_at.isoformat(), "id": rows[-1].id})
    return AttachmentPage(
        items=[_attachment_out(row) for row in rows],
        next_cursor=next_cursor,
        has_more=has_more,
    )


async def _load_owned(db: AsyncSession, user: User, attachment_id: uuid.UUID) -> Attachment:
    attachment = await db.get(Attachment, attachment_id)
    if attachment is None or attachment.user_id != user.id or attachment.status == "deleted":
        raise NotFoundError("附件不存在")
    return attachment


async def get_attachment(db: AsyncSession, user: User, attachment_id: uuid.UUID) -> AttachmentOut:
    return _attachment_out(await _load_owned(db, user, attachment_id))


async def delete_attachment(db: AsyncSession, user: User, attachment_id: uuid.UUID) -> None:
    attachment = await _load_owned(db, user, attachment_id)
    referenced = bool(
        await db.scalar(
            select(func.count(Message.id)).where(
                Message.attachments.cast(_jsonb_text).like(f'%"{attachment_id}"%')
            )
        )
    )
    path = Path(attachment.storage_path) if attachment.storage_path else None
    if referenced:
        # 被消息引用的附件走软删：历史消息快照仍可展示元数据，文件从磁盘移除。
        attachment.status = "deleted"
        attachment.storage_path = ""
    else:
        await db.delete(attachment)
    await write_audit(
        db,
        actor_type="user",
        actor_id=str(user.id),
        action="attachment.delete",
        resource_type="attachment",
        resource_id=str(attachment_id),
        detail={"soft_delete": referenced},
    )
    await db.commit()
    if path is not None and path.exists():
        path.unlink(missing_ok=True)


_jsonb_text = __import__("sqlalchemy").Text


async def open_attachment_file(db: AsyncSession, user: User, attachment_id: uuid.UUID) -> Path:

import hashlib
import logging
import shutil
import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import UploadFile
from sqlalchemy import and_, func, or_, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.audit import write_audit
from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.core.cursor import decode_cursor, encode_cursor
from app.core.errors import (
    CapabilityDisabledError,
    NotFoundError,
    PayloadTooLargeError,
    ValidationFailedError,
)
from app.db.models.attachment import Attachment
from app.db.models.conversation import Conversation, Message
from app.db.models.user import User
from app.modules.attachments.schemas import AttachmentOut, AttachmentPage

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# 可以被解码注入模型上下文的文本类型（其余只发快照）。
_TEXT_MIME_PREFIXES = ("text/", "application/json", "application/xml", "application/x-yaml")


def _now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _attachment_out(attachment: Attachment, *, duplicate: bool = False) -> AttachmentOut:
    return AttachmentOut(
        id=attachment.id,
        filename=attachment.filename,
        mime_type=attachment.mime_type,
        size_bytes=attachment.size_bytes,
        checksum=attachment.checksum,
        status=attachment.status,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        purpose=attachment.purpose,
        conversation_id=attachment.conversation_id,
        created_at=attachment.created_at,
        expires_at=attachment.expires_at,
        duplicate=duplicate,
    )


def _storage_dir(settings, user_id: uuid.UUID) -> Path:
    path = Path(settings.attachment_dir) / str(user_id)
    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return path


def _extract_text(mime_type: str, raw: bytes, max_chars: int) -> str | None:
    if not mime_type.startswith(_TEXT_MIME_PREFIXES):
        return None
    if len(raw) > 4 * 1024 * 1024:
        # 大文本不逐字解码（超长文本可能不是有效 UTF-8，也避免内存放大）。
        return raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")[:max_chars]
    return raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")[:max_chars]


async def create_attachment(
    db: AsyncSession,
    user: User,
    file: UploadFile,
    *,
    conversation_id: uuid.UUID | None,
    purpose: str,
) -> AttachmentOut:
    settings = get_settings()
    if not settings.attachments_enabled:
        raise CapabilityDisabledError("附件能力未启用")
    filename = (file.filename or "unnamed").strip()
    if not filename or len(filename) > 255:
        raise ValidationFailedError("文件名不合法")
    mime_type = (file.content_type or "application/octet-stream").split(";")[0].strip().lower()
    if mime_type not in settings.allowed_mime_type_list:
        raise ValidationFailedError(
            f"不支持的文件类型：{mime_type}", code="attachment_type_not_allowed"
        )
    if conversation_id is not None:
        conversation = await db.scalar(
            select(Conversation).where(
                Conversation.id == conversation_id,
                Conversation.user_id == user.id,
                Conversation.status != "deleted",
            )
        )
        if conversation is None:
            raise NotFoundError("会话不存在")

    raw = await file.read(settings.attachment_max_bytes + 1)
    if len(raw) > settings.attachment_max_bytes:
        raise PayloadTooLargeError(
            f"文件超过 {settings.attachment_max_bytes // (1024 * 1024)}MB 上限"
        )
    checksum = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

    # 同用户 + 同 checksum 去重：直接复用已有记录，不重复落盘。
    existing = await db.scalar(
        select(Attachment)
        .where(
            Attachment.user_id == user.id,
            Attachment.checksum == checksum,
            Attachment.status != "deleted",
        )
        .order_by(Attachment.created_at.desc())
        .limit(1)
    )
    if existing is not None:
        await write_audit(
            db,
            actor_type="user",
            actor_id=str(user.id),
            action="attachment.upload_deduplicated",
            resource_type="attachment",
            resource_id=str(existing.id),
            detail={"filename": filename[:200], "size": len(raw)},
        )
        await db.commit()
        return _attachment_out(existing, duplicate=True)

    attachment = Attachment(
        user_id=user.id,
        conversation_id=conversation_id,
        filename=filename,
        mime_type=mime_type,
        size_bytes=len(raw),
        checksum=checksum,
        status="processing",
        purpose=purpose,
        text_excerpt=_extract_text(mime_type, raw, settings.attachment_text_max_chars),
        expires_at=_now() + timedelta(hours=settings.attachment_retention_hours),
    )
    db.add(attachment)
    await db.flush()

    path = _storage_dir(settings, user.id) / f"{attachment.id}-{filename}"
    try:
        await _write_file(path, raw)
    except OSError:
        attachment.status = "failed"
        await db.commit()
        logger.exception("附件写盘失败 attachment_id=%s", attachment.id)
        raise
    attachment.storage_path = str(path)
    attachment.status = "ready"
    await write_audit(
        db,
        actor_type="user",
        actor_id=str(user.id),
        action="attachment.upload",
        resource_type="attachment",
        resource_id=str(attachment.id),
        detail={"filename": filename[:200], "size": len(raw), "checksum": checksum[:16]},
    )
    await db.commit()
    return _attachment_out(attachment)


async def _write_file(path: Path, raw: bytes) -> None:
    tmp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    tmp.write_bytes(raw)
    tmp.replace(path)


async def list_attachments(
    db: AsyncSession,
    user: User,
    *,
    conversation_id: uuid.UUID | None,
    limit: int,
    cursor: str | None,
) -> AttachmentPage:
    stmt = select(Attachment).where(
        Attachment.user_id == user.id, Attachment.status != "deleted"
    )
    if conversation_id is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(Attachment.conversation_id == conversation_id)
    cursor_data = decode_cursor(cursor)
    if cursor_data:
        raw_time = cursor_data.get("t")
        raw_id = cursor_data.get("id")
        try:
            last_time = datetime.fromisoformat(raw_time) if raw_time else None
            last_id = uuid.UUID(str(raw_id)) if raw_id else None
        except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
            raise ValidationFailedError("分页游标无效") from exc
        if last_time is None or last_id is None:
            raise ValidationFailedError("分页游标无效")
        stmt = stmt.where(
            or_(
                Attachment.created_at < last_time,
                and_(Attachment.created_at == last_time, Attachment.id < last_id),
            )
        )
    stmt = stmt.order_by(Attachment.created_at.desc(), Attachment.id.desc()).limit(limit + 1)
    rows = list((await db.execute(stmt)).scalars().all())
    has_more = len(rows) > limit
    rows = rows[:limit]
    next_cursor = None
    if has_more and rows:
        next_cursor = encode_cursor({"t": rows[-1].created_at.isoformat(), "id": rows[-1].id})
    return AttachmentPage(
        items=[_attachment_out(row) for row in rows],
        next_cursor=next_cursor,
        has_more=has_more,
    )


async def _load_owned(db: AsyncSession, user: User, attachment_id: uuid.UUID) -> Attachment:
    attachment = await db.get(Attachment, attachment_id)
    if attachment is None or attachment.user_id != user.id or attachment.status == "deleted":
        raise NotFoundError("附件不存在")
    return attachment


async def get_attachment(db: AsyncSession, user: User, attachment_id: uuid.UUID) -> AttachmentOut:
    return _attachment_out(await _load_owned(db, user, attachment_id))


async def delete_attachment(db: AsyncSession, user: User, attachment_id: uuid.UUID) -> None:
    attachment = await _load_owned(db, user, attachment_id)
    referenced = bool(
        await db.scalar(
            select(func.count(Message.id)).where(
                Message.attachments.cast(_jsonb_text).like(f'%"{attachment_id}"%')
            )
        )
    )
    path = Path(attachment.storage_path) if attachment.storage_path else None
    if referenced:
        # 被消息引用的附件走软删：历史消息快照仍可展示元数据，文件从磁盘移除。
        attachment.status = "deleted"
        attachment.storage_path = ""
    else:
        await db.delete(attachment)
    await write_audit(
        db,
        actor_type="user",
        actor_id=str(user.id),
        action="attachment.delete",
        resource_type="attachment",
        resource_id=str(attachment_id),
        detail={"soft_delete": referenced},
    )
    await db.commit()
    if path is not None and path.exists():
        path.unlink(missing_ok=True)


_jsonb_text = __import__("sqlalchemy").Text


async def open_attachment_file(db: AsyncSession, user: User, attachment_id: uuid.UUID) -> Path:
    """返回可下载的本地文件路径；归属或状态不合法抛 404。"""
    attachment = await _load_owned(db, user, attachment_id)
    if attachment.status != "ready":
        raise NotFoundError("附件不可下载")
    path = Path(attachment.storage_path)
    if not path.exists():
        raise NotFoundError("附件文件已丢失")
    return path

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_validator

# 代码内置的默认指令；管理员可通过 admin 接口或 system_settings['instruction.default'] 覆盖。
DEFAULT_INSTRUCTION = (
    "回答使用中文；先给结论再给依据；专业问题给出信息来源或说明推断过程；"
    "不确定时明确说明，不要编造。"
)

SYSTEM_KEY_INSTRUCTION = "instruction.default"


def _now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


class InstructionOut(BaseModel):
    effective: str
    source: str = Field(description="user：用户自定义；system_default：平台默认")
    user_value: str | None
    default_value: str
    max_chars: int
    updated_at: datetime


class InstructionUpdateRequest(BaseModel):
    content: str | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description="null 表示恢复平台默认；非空为整段覆盖，长度不得超过 max_chars",

    @field_validator("content")

    def _strip(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        if value is not None:
            stripped = value.strip()
            return stripped or None
        return None


class InstructionUpdateResult(BaseModel):
    effective: str
    source: str
    max_chars: int
    updated_at: datetime
    request_id: str | None = None

{"content": """"指令业务：读取系统默认与用户覆盖，合并出生效指令。"""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.audit import content_fingerprint, write_audit
from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.core.errors import CapabilityDisabledError, ValidationFailedError
from app.db.models.system import SystemSetting, UserSetting
from app.db.models.user import User
from app.modules.instructions.schemas import (
    DEFAULT_INSTRUCTION,
    SYSTEM_KEY_INSTRUCTION,
    InstructionOut,
    InstructionUpdateRequest,
    InstructionUpdateResult,
)


def _now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


async def _default_instruction(db: AsyncSession) -> tuple[str, datetime | None]:
    row = await db.get(SystemSetting, SYSTEM_KEY_INSTRUCTION)
    if row is None:
        return DEFAULT_INSTRUCTION, None
    value = row.value
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        content = value.get("content")
        if isinstance(content, str):
            return content, row.updated_at
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value, row.updated_at
    return DEFAULT_INSTRUCTION, None


async def get_effective(db: AsyncSession, user: User) -> InstructionOut:
    settings = get_settings()
    if not settings.instructions_enabled:
        raise CapabilityDisabledError("指令能力未启用")
    user_setting = await db.get(UserSetting, user.id)
    user_value = user_setting.instructions if user_setting else None
    default_value, _ = await _default_instruction(db)
    if user_value is not None:
        effective, source = user_value, "user"
        updated_at = user_setting.updated_at if user_setting else _now()
    else:
        effective, source = default_value, "system_default"
        _, updated_at = await _default_instruction(db)
        updated_at = updated_at or _now()
    return InstructionOut(
        effective=effective,
        source=source,
        user_value=user_value,
        default_value=default_value,
        max_chars=settings.instruction_max_chars,
        updated_at=updated_at,
    )


async def update_instruction(
    db: AsyncSession, user: User, payload: InstructionUpdateRequest
) -> InstructionUpdateResult:
    settings = get_settings()
    if not settings.instructions_enabled:

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import and_, func, or_, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.audit import content_fingerprint, write_audit

from app.core.cursor import decode_cursor, encode_cursor
from app.core.errors import CapabilityDisabledError, NotFoundError, ValidationFailedError
from app.db.models.memory import Memory
from app.db.models.user import User
from app.modules.memories.schemas import (
    MemoryCreateRequest,
    MemoryExportOut,
    MemoryOut,
    MemoryPage,
    MemoryUpdateRequest,
)


def _now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _memory_out(memory: Memory) -> MemoryOut:
    return MemoryOut(
        id=memory.id,
        kind=memory.kind,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        title=memory.title,
        content=memory.content,
        pinned=memory.pinned,
        status=memory.status,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        source=memory.source or {},
        created_at=memory.created_at,
        updated_at=memory.updated_at,
    )


def _require_enabled() -> None:
    if not get_settings().memories_enabled:
        raise CapabilityDisabledError("记忆能力未启用")


async def _stats(db: AsyncSession, user: User) -> dict[str, int]:
    rows = (

{"content": """"长期记忆业务：CRUD、清空、导出与聊天注入。

- q 在 M1.5 用 ILIKE 检索（语义检索在 M4 接入 embedding 后替换）；
- 保存去重 v1 用内容完全一致的 active 条目合并（语义去重后置）。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import and_, func, or_, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.audit import content_fingerprint, write_audit
from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.core.cursor import decode_cursor, encode_cursor
from app.core.errors import CapabilityDisabledError, NotFoundError, ValidationFailedError
from app.db.models.memory import Memory
from app.db.models.user import User
from app.modules.memories.schemas import (
    MemoryCreateRequest,
    MemoryExportOut,
    MemoryOut,
    MemoryPage,
    MemoryUpdateRequest,
)


def _now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _memory_out(memory: Memory) -> MemoryOut:
    return MemoryOut(
        id=memory.id,
        kind=memory.kind,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        title=memory.title,
        content=memory.content,
        pinned=memory.pinned,
        status=memory.status,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        source=memory.source or {},
        created_at=memory.created_at,
        updated_at=memory.updated_at,
    )


def _require_enabled() -> None:
    if not get_settings().memories_enabled:
        raise CapabilityDisabledError("记忆能力未启用")


async def _stats(db: AsyncSession, user: User) -> dict[str, int]:
    rows = (
        await db.execute(
            select(Memory.kind, Memory.status, func.count(Memory.id))
            .where(Memory.user_id == user.id)
            .group_by(Memory.kind, Memory.status)
        )
    ).all()
    stats = {"total": 0, "profile": 0, "preference": 0, "fact": 0, "active": 0, "archived": 0}
    for kind, status, count in rows:
        stats["total"] += int(count)
        if kind in stats:
            stats[kind] += int(count)
        if status in stats:
            stats[status] += int(count)
    return stats


async def list_memories(
    db: AsyncSession,
    user: User,
    *,
    kind: str | None,
    status: str | None,
    q: str | None,
    limit: int,
    cursor: str | None,
) -> MemoryPage:
    _require_enabled()
    stmt = select(Memory).where(Memory.user_id == user.id)
    if kind in {"profile", "preference", "fact"}:
        stmt = stmt.where(Memory.kind == kind)
    if status in {"active", "archived"}:
        stmt = stmt.where(Memory.status == status)
    if q:
        pattern = f"%{q.strip()}%"
        stmt = stmt.where(or_(Memory.content.ilike(pattern), Memory.title.ilike(pattern)))
    cursor_data = decode_cursor(cursor)
    if cursor_data:
        raw_time = cursor_data.get("t")
        raw_id = cursor_data.get("id")
        try:
            last_time = datetime.fromisoformat(raw_time) if raw_time else None
            last_id = uuid.UUID(str(raw_id)) if raw_id else None
        except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
            raise ValidationFailedError("分页游标无效") from exc
        if last_time is None or last_id is None:
            raise ValidationFailedError("分页游标无效")
        stmt = stmt.where(
            or_(
                Memory.updated_at < last_time,
                and_(Memory.updated_at == last_time, Memory.id < last_id),
            )
        )
    stmt = stmt.order_by(Memory.updated_at.desc(), Memory.id.desc()).limit(limit + 1)
    rows = list((await db.execute(stmt)).scalars().all())
    has_more = len(rows) > limit
    rows = rows[:limit]
    next_cursor = None
    if has_more and rows:
        next_cursor = encode_cursor({"t": rows[-1].updated_at.isoformat(), "id": rows[-1].id})
    return MemoryPage(
        items=[_memory_out(row) for row in rows],
        next_cursor=next_cursor,
        has_more=has_more,
        stats=await _stats(db, user),
    )


async def create_memory(
    db: AsyncSession,
    user: User,
    payload: MemoryCreateRequest,
    *,
    source: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> MemoryOut:
    _require_enabled()
    settings = get_settings()
    if len(payload.content) > settings.memory_max_item_chars:
        raise ValidationFailedError(f"记忆内容超过 {settings.memory_max_item_chars} 字符上限")
    memory = Memory(
        user_id=user.id,
        kind=payload.kind,
        title=payload.title,
        content=payload.content,
        pinned=payload.pinned,
        status="active",
        source=source or {},
    )
    db.add(memory)
    await write_audit(
        db,
        actor_type="user",
        actor_id=str(user.id),
        action="memory.create",
        resource_type="memory",
        resource_id=str(memory.id),
        detail={"kind": payload.kind, "length": len(payload.content), "fingerprint": content_fingerprint(payload.content)},
    )
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(memory)
    return _memory_out(memory)


async def _load_owned(db: AsyncSession, user: User, memory_id: uuid.UUID) -> Memory:
    _require_enabled()
    memory = await db.get(Memory, memory_id)
    if memory is None or memory.user_id != user.id:
        raise NotFoundError("记忆不存在")
    return memory


async def get_memory(db: AsyncSession, user: User, memory_id: uuid.UUID) -> MemoryOut:
    return _memory_out(await _load_owned(db, user, memory_id))


async def update_memory(
    db: AsyncSession, user: User, memory_id: uuid.UUID, payload: MemoryUpdateRequest
) -> MemoryOut:
    memory = await _load_owned(db, user, memory_id)
    settings = get_settings()
    if payload.content is not None:
        if len(payload.content) > settings.memory_max_item_chars:
            raise ValidationFailedError(
                f"记忆内容超过 {settings.memory_max_item_chars} 字符上限"
            )
        memory.content = payload.content
    if payload.kind is not None:
        memory.kind = payload.kind
    if payload.title is not None:
        memory.title = payload.title.strip()
    if payload.pinned is not None:
        if payload.pinned and memory.status == "active":
            pinned_count = await db.scalar(
                select(func.count(Memory.id)).where(
                    Memory.user_id == user.id,
                    Memory.pinned.is_(True),
                    Memory.status == "active",
                    Memory.id != memory.id,
                )
            )
            if int(pinned_count or 0) >= settings.memory_pinned_max:
                raise ValidationFailedError(
                    f"置顶记忆最多 {settings.memory_pinned_max} 条", code="memory_pinned_limit"
                )
        memory.pinned = payload.pinned
    if payload.status is not None:
        memory.status = payload.status
        if payload.status == "archived":
            memory.pinned = False
    await write_audit(
        db,
        actor_type="user",
        actor_id=str(user.id),
        action="memory.update",
        resource_type="memory",
        resource_id=str(memory_id),
        detail={
            "length": len(memory.content),
            "fingerprint": content_fingerprint(memory.content),
        },
    )
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(memory)
    return _memory_out(memory)


async def delete_memory(db: AsyncSession, user: User, memory_id: uuid.UUID) -> None:
    memory = await _load_owned(db, user, memory_id)
    await db.delete(memory)
    await write_audit(
        db,
        actor_type="user",
        actor_id=str(user.id),
        action="memory.delete",
        resource_type="memory",
        resource_id=str(memory_id),
        detail={"kind": memory.kind},
    )
    await db.commit()


async def clear_memories(db: AsyncSession, user: User) -> int:
    _require_enabled()
    count = await db.scalar(
        select(func.count(Memory.id)).where(Memory.user_id == user.id)
    )
    await db.execute(__import__("sqlalchemy").delete(Memory).where(Memory.user_id == user.id))
    await write_audit(
        db,
        actor_type="user",
        actor_id=str(user.id),
        action="memory.clear",
        resource_type="memory",
        resource_id=str(user.id),
        detail={"count": int(count or 0)},
    )
    await db.commit()
    return int(count or 0)


async def export_memories(db: AsyncSession, user: User) -> MemoryExportOut:
    _require_enabled()
    rows = list(
        (
            await db.execute(
                select(Memory)
                .where(Memory.user_id == user.id)
                .order_by(Memory.updated_at.desc(), Memory.id.desc())
            )
        ).scalars()
    )
    return MemoryExportOut(exported_at=_now(), items=[_memory_out(row) for row in rows])


async def active_memories_for_injection(db: AsyncSession, user: User, max_tokens: int) -> list[Memory]:
    """聊天装配用：置顶在前，其余按更新时间倒序，按保守 token 预算截断。"""
    if not get_settings().memories_enabled:
        return []
    rows = list(
        (
            await db.execute(
                select(Memory)
                .where(Memory.user_id == user.id, Memory.status == "active")
                .order_by(Memory.pinned.desc(), Memory.updated_at.desc(), Memory.id.desc())
                .limit(200)
            )
        ).scalars()
    )
    picked: list[Memory] = []
    budget = max_tokens
    for row in rows:
        cost = _estimate_tokens(row.content)
        if budget - cost < 0 and picked:
            break
        picked.append(row)
        budget -= cost
    return picked


def _estimate_tokens(text: str) -> int:
    """保守估算：CJK 1 token/字，其余 0.3 token/字符。"""
    cjk = sum(1 for ch in text if "\u4e00" <= ch <= "\u9fff")
    return cjk + max(1, int((len(text) - cjk) * 0.3))


async def save_memory_for_tool(
    db: AsyncSession,
    user: User,
    *,
    content: str,
    kind: str,
    title: str | None,
    pinned: bool | None,
) -> tuple[Memory, str]:
    """save_memory 原生工具调用；内容完全一致的 active 条目合并更新。"""
    existing = await db.scalar(
        select(Memory)
        .where(
            Memory.user_id == user.id,
            Memory.status == "active",
            Memory.content == content,
        )
        .order_by(Memory.updated_at.desc())
        .limit(1)
    )
    if existing is not None:
        existing.updated_at = _now()
        if kind:
            existing.kind = kind
        if title:
            existing.title = title
        await write_audit(
            db,
            actor_type="agent",
            actor_id=str(user.id),
            action="memory.update",
            resource_type="memory",
            resource_id=str(existing.id),
            detail={"length": len(content), "fingerprint": content_fingerprint(content)},
        )
        await db.commit()
        return existing, "updated"
    payload = MemoryCreateRequest(
        kind=kind or "fact", title=title or "", content=content, pinned=bool(pinned)
    )
    memory = await create_memory(
        db,
        user,
        payload,
        source={"created_by": "agent"},
    )
    return await _load_owned(db, user, memory.id), "created"

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import logging
import re
import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import UploadFile
from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.audit import content_fingerprint, write_audit
from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.core.errors import (
    CapabilityDisabledError,
    ConflictError,
    NotFoundError,
    ValidationFailedError,
)
from app.db.models.mcp import UserCapabilityOverride
from app.db.models.skill import Skill, SkillFile
from app.db.models.user import User
from app.modules.skills.importer import ParsedSkill, estimate_tokens, parse_skill_zip
from app.modules.skills.schemas import (
    SkillCatalogListOut,
    SkillCatalogOut,
    SkillDetailOut,
    SkillFileContentOut,
    SkillImportResult,
    SkillListOut,
    SkillOut,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_SLUGIFY_PATTERN = re.compile(r"[^a-z0-9-]+")
_BUILTIN_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "agents" / "skills"


def _now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _slugify(name: str) -> str:
    slug = _SLUGIFY_PATTERN.sub("-", name.lower()).strip("-")
    return (slug or "skill")[:64]


def _skill_out(skill: Skill, *, effective: bool | None = None) -> SkillOut:
    return SkillOut(
        id=skill.id,
        scope=skill.scope,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        slug=skill.slug,
        name=skill.name,
        description=skill.description,
        version=skill.version,
        source=skill.source,
        enabled=skill.enabled,
        force_disabled=skill.force_disabled,
        effective_enabled=skill.enabled if effective is None else effective,
        estimated_tokens=skill.estimated_tokens,
        size_bytes=skill.size_bytes,
        file_count=skill.file_count,
        created_at=skill.created_at,
        updated_at=skill.updated_at,
    )


def _require_enabled() -> None:
    if not get_settings().skills_enabled:
        raise CapabilityDisabledError("技能能力未启用")


async def _effective_enabled(db: AsyncSession, skill: Skill, user: User | None) -> bool:
    if skill.force_disabled:
        return False
    if skill.scope == "user":
        return skill.enabled
    if user is None:
        return skill.enabled
    override = await db.scalar(
        select(UserCapabilityOverride.enabled).where(
            UserCapabilityOverride.user_id == user.id,
            UserCapabilityOverride.capability == "skill",
            UserCapabilityOverride.target_id == skill.id,
        )
    )
    return skill.enabled if override is None else override


async def list_skills(
    db: AsyncSession, user: User, *, q: str | None = None
) -> SkillListOut:
    _require_enabled()
    stmt = select(Skill).where(
        (Skill.scope == "system") | (Skill.owner_user_id == user.id)
    )
    if q:
        pattern = f"%{q.strip()}%"
        stmt = stmt.where(Skill.name.ilike(pattern) | Skill.description.ilike(pattern))
    rows = list((await db.execute(stmt.order_by(Skill.created_at.desc()))).scalars())
    stats = {"total": len(rows), "system": 0, "user": 0, "enabled": 0}
    items: list[SkillOut] = []
    for row in rows:
        effective = await _effective_enabled(db, row, user)
        stats[row.scope] += 1
        if effective:
            stats["enabled"] += 1
        items.append(_skill_out(row, effective=effective))
    return SkillListOut(items=items, stats=stats)


async def catalog(db: AsyncSession, user: User) -> SkillCatalogListOut:
    """输入框 @ 选择器用的精简目录（仅有效启用项）。"""
    settings = get_settings()
    if not settings.skills_enabled:
        raise CapabilityDisabledError("技能能力未启用")
    rows = list(
        (
            await db.execute(
                select(Skill)
                .where((Skill.scope == "system") | (Skill.owner_user_id == user.id))
                .order_by(Skill.scope.desc(), Skill.created_at.desc())
                .limit(settings.skill_catalog_max_items)
            )
        ).scalars()
    )
    items: list[SkillCatalogOut] = []
    for row in rows:
        effective = await _effective_enabled(db, row, user)
        if not effective:
            continue
        items.append(
            SkillCatalogOut(
                id=row.id,
                scope=row.scope,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                slug=row.slug,
                name=row.name,
                description=row.description,
                effective_enabled=True,
                estimated_tokens=row.estimated_tokens,
            )
        )
    return SkillCatalogListOut(items=items)


async def _load_visible(db: AsyncSession, user: User, skill_id: uuid.UUID) -> Skill:
    _require_enabled()
    skill = await db.get(Skill, skill_id)
    if skill is None or (skill.scope == "user" and skill.owner_user_id != user.id):
        raise NotFoundError("技能不存在")
    return skill


async def get_skill(db: AsyncSession, user: User, skill_id: uuid.UUID) -> SkillDetailOut:
    skill = await _load_visible(db, user, skill_id)
    files = list(
        (
            await db.execute(
                select(SkillFile)
                .where(SkillFile.skill_id == skill.id)
                .order_by(SkillFile.path.asc())
            )
        ).scalars()
    )
    effective = await _effective_enabled(db, skill, user)
    detail = SkillDetailOut(
        **_skill_out(skill, effective=effective).model_dump(),
        content=skill.content,
        metadata=skill.metadata_ or {},
        files=[SkillFileOut(path=item.path, size_bytes=item.size_bytes) for item in files],
    )
    return detail


async def create_skill(
    db: AsyncSession,
    user: User,
    *,
    name: str,
    description: str,
    content: str,
) -> SkillDetailOut:
    _require_enabled()
    settings = get_settings()
    tokens = estimate_tokens(content)
    if tokens > settings.skill_max_body_tokens:
        raise ValidationFailedError(
            f"技能正文约 {tokens} tokens，超过 {settings.skill_max_body_tokens} 上限",
            code="skill_invalid",
        )
    slug = _slugify(name)
    base = slug
    for attempt in range(5):
        exists = await db.scalar(
            select(Skill.id).where(
                Skill.scope == "user", Skill.owner_user_id == user.id, Skill.slug == slug
            )
        )
        if exists is None:
            break
        slug = f"{base[:56]}-{hashlib.sha1(f'{attempt}'.encode()).hexdigest()[:6]}"
    skill = Skill(
        scope="user",
        owner_user_id=user.id,
        slug=slug,
        name=name,
        description=description,
        content=content,
        version="1.0",
        source="manual",
        enabled=True,
        estimated_tokens=tokens,
        size_bytes=len(content.encode()),
        file_count=0,
        metadata_={},
    )
    db.add(skill)
    await write_audit(
        db,
        actor_type="user",
        actor_id=str(user.id),
        action="skill.create",
        resource_type="skill",
        resource_id=str(skill.id),
        detail={"slug": slug, "length": len(content)},
    )
    try:
        await db.commit()
    except IntegrityError as exc:
        await db.rollback()
        raise ConflictError("技能 slug 已存在") from exc
    await db.refresh(skill)
    return await get_skill(db, user, skill.id)


async def import_skill(db: AsyncSession, user: User, file: UploadFile) -> SkillImportResult:
    _require_enabled()
    raw = await file.read(get_settings().skill_max_upload_bytes + 1)
    parsed = parse_skill_zip(raw)
    exists = await db.scalar(
        select(Skill.id).where(
            Skill.scope == "user", Skill.owner_user_id == user.id, Skill.slug == parsed.slug
        )
    )
    if exists is not None:
        raise ConflictError("同名技能已存在", details={"slug": parsed.slug})
    skill = Skill(
        scope="user",
        owner_user_id=user.id,
        slug=parsed.slug,
        name=parsed.name,
        description=parsed.description,
        content=parsed.content,
        version=parsed.version,
        source="upload",
        enabled=True,
        estimated_tokens=parsed.estimated_tokens,
        size_bytes=parsed.size_bytes,
        file_count=len(parsed.files),
        metadata_=parsed.metadata,
    )
    db.add(skill)
    await db.flush()
    for item in parsed.files:
        db.add(
            SkillFile(
                skill_id=skill.id,
                path=item.path,
                content=item.content,
                size_bytes=item.size_bytes,
            )
        )
    await write_audit(
        db,
        actor_type="user",
        actor_id=str(user.id),
        action="skill.import",

async def sync_builtin_skills(db: AsyncSession) -> int:
    """启动时把仓库内 ``app/agents/skills/<slug>/`` 幂等同步为系统技能。

    仓库中已删除的内置技能标记 ``force_disabled=true``（不物理删除，
    防止用户覆盖把下架技能复活）。
    """
    if not _BUILTIN_DIR.exists():
        return 0
    slugs_on_disk: set[str] = set()
    changed = 0
    for skill_dir in sorted(_BUILTIN_DIR.iterdir()):
        if not skill_dir.is_dir():
            continue
        skill_md = skill_dir / "SKILL.md"
        if not skill_md.exists():
            logger.warning("内置技能缺少 SKILL.md：%s", skill_dir.name)
            continue
        raw = skill_md.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        # 复用导入器解析，保证内置技能与用户上传同一条校验链。
        try:
            parsed = parse_skill_zip(_zip_from_dir(skill_dir))
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("内置技能解析失败：%s", skill_dir.name)
            continue
        slugs_on_disk.add(parsed.slug)
        existing = await db.scalar(select(Skill).where(Skill.scope == "system", Skill.slug == parsed.slug))
        if existing is None:
            existing = Skill(
                scope="system",
                owner_user_id=None,
                slug=parsed.slug,
                name=parsed.name,
                description=parsed.description,
                content=parsed.content,
                version=parsed.version,
                source="builtin",
                enabled=True,
                force_disabled=False,
                estimated_tokens=parsed.estimated_tokens,
                size_bytes=parsed.size_bytes,
                file_count=len(parsed.files),
                metadata_=parsed.metadata,
            )
            db.add(existing)
            await db.flush()
            changed += 1
        else:
            updated = False
            for field_name, value in (
                ("name", parsed.name),
                ("description", parsed.description),
                ("content", parsed.content),
                ("version", parsed.version),
                ("estimated_tokens", parsed.estimated_tokens),
                ("size_bytes", parsed.size_bytes),
                ("file_count", len(parsed.files)),
            ):
                if getattr(existing, field_name) != value:
                    setattr(existing, field_name, value)
                    updated = True
            if updated:
                changed += 1
        if parsed.files:
            await db.execute(
                __import__("sqlalchemy").delete(SkillFile).where(SkillFile.skill_id == existing.id)
            )
            for item in parsed.files:
                db.add(
                    SkillFile(
                        skill_id=existing.id,
                        path=item.path,
                        content=item.content,
                        size_bytes=item.size_bytes,
                    )
                )
    # 仓库下架的内置技能：防复活。
    rows = list(
        (await db.execute(select(Skill).where(Skill.scope == "system"))).scalars()
    )
    for row in rows:
        if row.slug not in slugs_on_disk and not row.force_disabled:
            row.force_disabled = True
            changed += 1
    await db.commit()
    return changed


def _zip_from_dir(skill_dir: Path) -> bytes:
    import io
    import zipfile

    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(buffer, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
        for path in sorted(skill_dir.rglob("*")):
            if path.is_file():
                archive.write(path, path.relative_to(skill_dir).as_posix())
    return buffer.getvalue()

    stats["total"] += 1
    stats[scope] += 1
    if effective:
        stats["enabled"] += 1

    content: str,
) -> SkillDetailOut:

    settings = get_settings()
    tokens = estimate_tokens(content)
    if tokens > settings.skill_max_body_tokens:

        slug = f"{base[:56]}-{hashlib.sha1(f'{attempt}'.encode()).hexdigest()[:6]}"

        scope="user",

        name=name,
        description=description,
        content=content,
        version="1.0",
        source="manual",
        enabled=True,
        estimated_tokens=tokens,
        size_bytes=len(content.encode()),
        file_count=0,
        metadata_={},

    db.add(skill)
    await write_audit(

        actor_type="user",

def _skill_out(skill: Skill, *, effective: bool | None = None) -> SkillOut:

async def _effective_enabled(db: AsyncSession, skill: Skill, user: User | None) -> bool:
    if skill.force_disabled:
        return False
    if skill.scope == "user":
        return skill.enabled
    if user is None:
        return skill.enabled
    override = await db.scalar(
        select(UserCapabilityOverride.enabled).where(
            UserCapabilityOverride.user_id == user.id,
            UserCapabilityOverride.capability == "skill",
            UserCapabilityOverride.target_id == skill.id,
        )
    )
    return skill.enabled if override is None else override


async def list_skills(
    db: AsyncSession, user: User, *, q: str | None = None
) -> SkillListOut:
    _require_enabled()
    stmt = select(Skill).where(
        (Skill.scope == "system") | (Skill.owner_user_id == user.id)
    )
    if q:
        pattern = f"%{q.strip()}%"
        stmt = stmt.where(Skill.name.ilike(pattern) | Skill.description.ilike(pattern))
    rows = list((await db.execute(stmt.order_by(Skill.created_at.desc()))).scalars())
    stats = {"total": len(rows), "system": 0, "user": 0, "enabled": 0}
    items: list[SkillOut] = []
    for row in rows:
        effective = await _effective_enabled(db, row, user)

    rows = list(
        (
            await db.execute(
                select(Skill)
                .where((Skill.scope == "system") | (Skill.owner_user_id == user.id))
                .order_by(Skill.scope.desc(), Skill.created_at.desc())
                .limit(settings.skill_catalog_max_items)
            )
        ).scalars()

    items: list[SkillCatalogOut] = []

async def create_skill(
    db: AsyncSession,
    user: User,
    *,
    name: str,
    description: str,
    content: str,
) -> SkillDetailOut:
    _require_enabled()
    settings = get_settings()
    tokens = estimate_tokens(content)
    if tokens > settings.skill_max_body_tokens:
        raise ValidationFailedError(
            f"技能正文约 {tokens} tokens，超过 {settings.skill_max_body_tokens} 上限",
            code="skill_invalid",
        )
    slug = _slugify(name)
    base = slug
    for attempt in range(5):
        exists = await db.scalar(
            select(Skill.id).where(
                Skill.scope == "user", Skill.owner_user_id == user.id, Skill.slug == slug
            )
        )
        if exists is None:
            break
        slug = f"{base[:56]}-{hashlib.sha1(f'{attempt}'.encode()).hexdigest()[:6]}"
    skill = Skill(
        scope="user",
        owner_user_id=user.id,
        slug=slug,
        name=name,
        description=description,
        content=content,
        version="1.0",
        source="manual",
        enabled=True,
        estimated_tokens=tokens,
        size_bytes=len(content.encode()),
        file_count=0,
        metadata_={},
    )
    db.add(skill)
    await write_audit(
        db,
        actor_type="user",
        actor_id=str(user.id),
        action="skill.create",
        resource_type="skill",
        resource_id=str(skill.id),
        detail={"slug": slug, "length": len(content)},
    )

        await db.rollback()

    return await get_skill(db, user, skill.id)

        select(Skill.id).where(

        )
    )
    if exists is not None:
        raise ConflictError("同名技能已存在", details={"slug": parsed.slug})
    skill = Skill(
        scope="user",
        owner_user_id=user.id,
        slug=parsed.slug,
        name=parsed.name,
        description=parsed.description,
        content=parsed.content,
        version=parsed.version,
        source="upload",
        enabled=True,
        estimated_tokens=parsed.estimated_tokens,
        size_bytes=parsed.size_bytes,
        file_count=len(parsed.files),

    db.add(skill)
    await db.flush()
    for item in parsed.files:
        db.add(

                content=item.content,
                size_bytes=item.size_bytes,

    skill = await _load_visible(db, user, skill_id)
    normalized = _normalize_skill_path(path)
    row = await db.scalar(
        select(SkillFile).where(SkillFile.skill_id == skill.id, SkillFile.path == normalized)
    )
    if row is None:

    settings = get_settings()
    if row.size_bytes > settings.skill_file_read_max_bytes:
        raise ValidationFailedError(
            f"文件超过 {settings.skill_file_read_max_bytes // 1024}KB 读取上限",

    )


def _normalize_skill_path(path: str) -> str:
    path = path.replace("\\", "/")
    parts = [part for part in path.split("/") if part not in {"", "."}]
    if not parts or any(part == ".." for part in parts):
        raise ValidationFailedError("非法文件路径")
    return "/".join(parts)

    if tokens > settings.skill_max_body_tokens:

        db,

        actor_id=str(user.id),

    exists = await db.scalar(
        select(Skill.id).where(
            Skill.scope == "user", Skill.owner_user_id == user.id, Skill.slug == parsed.slug
        )
    )
    if exists is not None:
        raise ConflictError("同名技能已存在", details={"slug": parsed.slug})
    skill = Skill(
        scope="user",
        owner_user_id=user.id,
        slug=parsed.slug,
        name=parsed.name,
        description=parsed.description,
        content=parsed.content,
        version=parsed.version,
        source="upload",
        enabled=True,
        estimated_tokens=parsed.estimated_tokens,
        size_bytes=parsed.size_bytes,
        file_count=len(parsed.files),
        metadata_=parsed.metadata,
    )
    db.add(skill)
    await db.flush()
    for item in parsed.files:
        db.add(
            SkillFile(
                skill_id=skill.id,
                path=item.path,
                content=item.content,
                size_bytes=item.size_bytes,
            )
        )
    await write_audit(
        db,
        actor_type="user",
        actor_id=str(user.id),

        resource_id=str(skill.id),

    )
    try:
        await db.commit()
    except IntegrityError as exc:
        await db.rollback()
