class ToolRunner:
    """一次运行内的工具执行上下文；由 execute_run 构造后交给图的工具节点。"""

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        run_id: uuid.UUID,
        publisher: RunEventPublisher,
        user_id: uuid.UUID,
        user_role: str,
        mcp_tools: dict[str, ChatMcpTool],
        active_skill_ids: set[str],
    ) -> None:
        self.run_id = run_id
        self.publisher = publisher
        self.user_id = user_id
        self.user_role = user_role
        self.mcp_tools = mcp_tools
        self.active_skill_ids = active_skill_ids

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ 图入口

    async def execute(self, state: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        messages = state.get("messages", [])
        last = messages[-1] if messages else None
        if last is None:
            return {"messages": []}
        tool_calls = getattr(last, "tool_calls", None) or []
        results = [await self._execute_one(call) for call in tool_calls]
        return {"messages": results}

    async def _execute_one(self, call: dict[str, Any]) -> ToolMessage:
        tool_call_id = str(call.get("id") or uuid.uuid4())
        name = str(call.get("name") or "")
        args = call.get("args") or {}
        source, server_slug = self._classify(name)
        await self.publisher.emit(
            "tool.start",
            {
                "tool_call_id": tool_call_id,
                "tool": name,
                "args": args,
                "source": source,
                **({"server": server_slug} if server_slug else {}),
            },
            event_type="tool",
            title=f"调用工具 {name}",
            subtitle=_compact(args, 200),
        )
        started = _now()
        invocation = await self._create_invocation(
            tool_call_id, name, source, server_slug, args
        )
        status = "ok"
        summary = ""
        error: str | None = None
        try:
            if name == "save_memory":
                content, summary = await self._run_save_memory(args)
            elif name == "read_skill_file":
                content, summary = await self._run_read_skill_file(args)
            else:
                content, summary = await self._run_mcp(tool_call_id, name, args)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            await self._finish_invocation(invocation, "canceled", None, started)
            raise
        except ApprovalTimeoutError as exc:
            await self._finish_invocation(invocation, "canceled", "审批超时", started)
            raise exc
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - 工具错误统一回填模型
            logger.warning("工具执行失败 tool=%s：%s", name, exc)
            status = "error"
            error = str(exc)[:500]
            summary = error[:200]
            content = f"工具 {name} 执行失败：{error}"
        await self._finish_invocation(invocation, status, error, started)
        await self.publisher.emit(
            "tool.result",
            {
                "tool_call_id": tool_call_id,
                "tool": name,
                "status": status,
                "summary": summary[:500],
                "source": source,
                **({"server": server_slug} if server_slug else {}),
            },
            event_type="tool",
            status="error" if status == "error" else "ok",
            title=f"工具结果 {name}",
            subtitle=summary[:200],
            duration_ms=int((_now() - started).total_seconds() * 1000),
        )
        return ToolMessage(content=content, tool_call_id=tool_call_id, name=name)

    def _classify(self, name: str) -> tuple[str, str | None]:
        if name in {"save_memory", "read_skill_file"}:
            return "skill" if name == "read_skill_file" else "native", None
        if name.startswith("mcp__"):
            context = self.mcp_tools.get(name)
            if context is not None:
                return "mcp", context.slug
            return "mcp", None
        return "native", None

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ 落库

    async def _create_invocation(
        self, tool_call_id: str, name: str, source: str, source_id: str | None, args: dict
    ) -> ToolInvocation:
        invocation = ToolInvocation(
            run_id=self.run_id,
            tool_call_id=tool_call_id,
            tool_name=name,
            source=source,
            source_id=source_id,
            status="pending",
            args=self._sanitize_args(args),
        )
        async with get_session_factory()() as db:
            db.add(invocation)
            await db.commit()
            await db.refresh(invocation)
        return invocation

    async def _finish_invocation(
        self, invocation: ToolInvocation, status: str, error: str | None, started: datetime
    ) -> None:
        async with get_session_factory()() as db:
            row = await db.get(ToolInvocation, invocation.id)
            if row is not None:
                row.status = status
                row.error = error
                row.duration_ms = int((_now() - started).total_seconds() * 1000)
                row.finished_at = _now()
                await db.commit()

    @staticmethod
    def _sanitize_args(args: dict[str, Any], limit: int = 4000) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return json.loads(_compact(args, limit)) if _compact(args, limit).strip() else {}

    async def _load_user(self) -> User:
        async with get_session_factory()() as db:
            user = await db.get(User, self.user_id)
        if user is None:
            raise RuntimeError("运行用户不存在")
        return user

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ 原生工具

    async def _run_save_memory(self, args: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[str, str]:
        settings = get_settings()
        async with get_session_factory()() as db:
            user = await db.get(User, self.user_id)
            if user is None:
                raise RuntimeError("运行用户不存在")
            content = str(args.get("content") or "").strip()[: settings.memory_max_item_chars]
            if not content:
                raise ValueError("记忆内容不能为空")
            memory, action = await memories_service.save_memory_for_tool(
                db,
                user,
                content=content,
                kind=str(args.get("kind") or "fact"),
                title=str(args.get("title") or "")[:200],
                pinned=bool(args.get("pinned")),
            )
        preview = content[:80] + ("…" if len(content) > 80 else "")
        await self.publisher.emit(
            "memory.saved",
            {
                "memory_id": str(memory.id),
                "kind": memory.kind,
                "action": action,
                "preview": preview,
            },
            event_type="tool",
            title="记忆已保存" if action == "created" else "记忆已更新",
            subtitle=preview,
        )
        return (
            f"记忆已保存：memory_id={memory.id}，action={action}",
            f"{action}: {preview}",
        )

    async def _run_read_skill_file(self, args: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[str, str]:
        skill_id_raw = str(args.get("skill_id") or "")
        try:
            skill_id = uuid.UUID(skill_id_raw)
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise ValueError("skill_id 不合法") from exc
        if skill_id_raw not in self.active_skill_ids:
            raise ValueError("只能读取本轮已激活技能的文件")
        path = str(args.get("path") or "")
        async with get_session_factory()() as db:
            user = await db.get(User, self.user_id)
            if user is None:
                raise RuntimeError("运行用户不存在")
            result = await skills_service.read_file(db, user, skill_id, path)
        content = result.content
        return content, f"读取 {result.path}（{result.size_bytes} 字节）"

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ MCP 工具

    async def _run_mcp(self, tool_call_id: str, name: str, args: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[str, str]:
        context = self.mcp_tools.get(name)
        if context is None:
            raise ValueError(f"工具 {name} 不在本轮目录中")
        async with get_session_factory()() as db:
            server = await db.get(McpServer, context.server_id)
            if server is None or not server.enabled:
                raise ValueError("MCP 服务器已不可用")
            if context.requires_approval:
                decision = await self._wait_approval(
                    db=db,
                    tool_call_id=tool_call_id,
                    tool_name=name,
                    display_name=name,
                    risk=context.risk,
                    args=args,
                    source="mcp",
                    executor=server.slug,
                    target=server.url or "",
                )
                if decision != "approve":
                    return (
                        "用户拒绝了本次工具调用，未执行任何操作。",
                        "rejected: 用户拒绝执行",
                    )
            client = _client_for(server)
            result = await client.call_tool(context.exposed_name.split("__", 2)[-1], args)
            if isinstance(client, object) and hasattr(client, "close"):
                await client.close()
        text = self._tool_result_text(result)
        return text, text[:500]

    @staticmethod
    def _tool_result_text(result: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        content = result.get("content")
        if isinstance(content, list):
            parts: list[str] = []
            for item in content:
                if isinstance(item, dict) and isinstance(item.get("text"), str):
                    parts.append(item["text"])
            if parts:
                return "\n".join(parts)
        if result.get("_truncated"):
            return f"[响应已截断] {_compact(result.get('error') or result)}"
        if isinstance(content, str):
            return content
        return _compact(result, 2000)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ HITL

    async def _wait_approval(
        self,
        *,
        db,
        tool_call_id: str,
        tool_name: str,
        display_name: str,
        risk: str,
        args: dict[str, Any],
        source: str,
        executor: str,
        target: str,
    ) -> str:
        settings = get_settings()
        now = _now()
        preview = _compact(args, 500)
        approval = Approval(
            run_id=self.run_id,
            tool_name=tool_name,
            tool_display_name=display_name,
            source=source,
            executor=executor,
            target=target[:2000],
            side_effect=self._side_effect(risk),
            risk=risk if risk in {"read", "write", "destructive", "unknown"} else "unknown",
            reason=f"工具「{tool_name}」需要人工确认后执行",
            payload=self._sanitize_args(args),
            payload_preview=preview,
            status="pending",
            expires_at=now + timedelta(seconds=settings.approval_timeout_seconds),
        )
        db.add(approval)
        await db.commit()
        await db.refresh(approval)

        await self.publisher.emit(
            "approval.required",
            {
                "approval_id": str(approval.id),
                "tool_call_id": tool_call_id,
                "tool": tool_name,
                "source": source,
                "risk": approval.risk,
                "reason": approval.reason,
                "payload": approval.payload,
                "expires_at": approval.expires_at.isoformat() if approval.expires_at else None,
            },
            event_type="approval",
            title="等待人工确认",
            subtitle=f"{tool_name}：{preview}",
        )

        context: RunContext | None = registry.get(self.run_id)
        if context is None:
            raise RuntimeError("运行上下文不存在，无法等待审批")
        context.reset_approval_wait()
        try:
            await asyncio.wait_for(
                context.approval_event.wait(),
                timeout=settings.approval_timeout_seconds,
            )
        except TimeoutError:
            await self._expire_approval(approval.id)
            raise ApprovalTimeoutError(approval.id) from None
        if context.cancel_requested:
            raise asyncio.CancelledError
        decision = (context.approval_decision or {}).get("decision")
        if decision not in {"approve", "reject"}:
            raise RuntimeError("审批状态异常")
        return decision

    async def _expire_approval(self, approval_id: uuid.UUID) -> None:
        async with get_session_factory()() as db:
            approval = await db.get(Approval, approval_id)
            if approval is not None and approval.status == "pending":
                approval.status = "expired"
                await db.commit()

    @staticmethod
    def _side_effect(risk: str) -> str:
        return {
            "read": "只读操作，无外部副作用",
            "write": "写操作：会修改外部系统数据",
            "destructive": "破坏性操作：删除/覆盖等不可逆变更",
            "unknown": "操作副作用未知",
        }.get(risk, "操作副作用未知")

def _type_of(spec: dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
    kind = spec.get("type")
    if isinstance(kind, list):
        kinds = [item for item in kind if item != "null"]
        kind = kinds[0] if kinds else None
    return {
        "string": str,
        "integer": int,
        "number": float,
        "boolean": bool,
        "array": list,
        "object": dict,
    }.get(kind, Any)


def _args_model(name: str, schema: dict[str, Any]) -> type[BaseModel]:
    properties = schema.get("properties") if isinstance(schema.get("properties"), dict) else {}
    required = set(schema.get("required") or [])
    fields: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for prop, spec in properties.items():
        if not isinstance(spec, dict) or not prop.isidentifier():
            continue
        description = str(spec.get("description") or "")[:500]
        if prop in required:
            fields[prop] = (
                _type_of(spec),
                Field(description=description),
            )
        else:
            fields[prop] = (_type_of(spec), Field(default=None, description=description))
    model_name = f"McpArgs_{name.replace('__', '_')[:40]}"
    return create_model(model_name, **fields)

    """把本轮 MCP 工具目录转成 LangChain 工具。"""
    tools: list[StructuredTool] = []
    for exposed_name, context in mcp_tools.items():
        args_model = _args_model(exposed_name, context.input_schema)

        async def call_mcp(_ctx=context, **kwargs: Any) -> str:
            return await runner._native_mcp_call(_ctx, kwargs)

        tools.append(
            StructuredTool.from_function(
                coroutine=call_mcp,
                name=exposed_name,
                description=context.description[:2000],
                args_schema=args_model,
            )
        )
    return tools

{"content": """"聊天能力装配：附件快照、指令、记忆、技能与 MCP 的运行时合并。

装配结果每轮生成，不写 checkpoint；账号级配置修改下一轮立即生效。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.agents.prompts import (
    assemble_system_prompt,
    format_memory_line,
    truncate_to_tokens,
)
from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.core.errors import CapabilityDisabledError, NotFoundError, ValidationFailedError
from app.db.models.attachment import Attachment
from app.db.models.mcp import McpTool
from app.db.models.skill import Skill
from app.db.models.user import User
from app.modules.chat.schemas import ChatStreamRequest
from app.modules.instructions import service as instructions_service
from app.modules.mcp.service import ChatMcpTool, collect_chat_tools
from app.modules.memories import service as memories_service
from app.modules.skills import service as skills_service


@dataclass
class AssembledCapabilities:
    system_prompt: str = ""
    tools: list[Any] = field(default_factory=list)
    mcp_tool_map: dict[str, ChatMcpTool] = field(default_factory=dict)
    skill_activations: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    notices: list[dict[str, str]] = field(default_factory=list)
    attachment_snapshot: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    attachment_text: str = ""
    active_skill_ids: set[str] = field(default_factory=set)


async def validate_chat_selections(db: AsyncSession, user: User, payload: ChatStreamRequest) -> None:
    """start_chat 阶段的快速校验：资源必须存在、归属本人、当前可用。

    完整装配在 execute_run 里进行；这里只把 4xx 提前到 HTTP 层。
    """
    settings = get_settings()
    if payload.attachments:
        if not settings.attachments_enabled:
            raise CapabilityDisabledError("附件能力未启用")
        await load_attachments(db, user, payload.attachments)
    if payload.skills:
        if not settings.skills_enabled:
            raise CapabilityDisabledError("技能能力未启用")
        await validate_skill_ids(db, user, payload.skills)
    if payload.mcp_servers or payload.mcp_tools:
        if not settings.mcp_enabled:
            raise CapabilityDisabledError("MCP 能力未启用")
        await collect_chat_tools(
            db,
            user,
            explicit_servers=list(payload.mcp_servers),
            explicit_tools=list(payload.mcp_tools),
        )


async def load_attachments(
    db: AsyncSession, user: User, attachment_ids: list[uuid.UUID]
) -> list[Attachment]:
    """校验附件归属与状态，返回可用附件；越权/不存在 404，未就绪 422。"""
    seen: set[uuid.UUID] = set()
    attachments: list[Attachment] = []
    for attachment_id in attachment_ids:
        if attachment_id in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(attachment_id)
        attachment = await db.get(Attachment, attachment_id)
        if attachment is None or attachment.user_id != user.id or attachment.status == "deleted":
            raise NotFoundError("附件不存在")
        if attachment.status != "ready":
            raise ValidationFailedError(
                f"附件「{attachment.filename}」尚未就绪", code="attachment_not_ready"
            )
        attachments.append(attachment)
    return attachments


async def validate_skill_ids(db: AsyncSession, user: User, skill_ids: list[uuid.UUID]) -> None:
    settings = get_settings()
    total_tokens = 0
    for skill_id in skill_ids:
        skill = await db.get(Skill, skill_id)
        if skill is None or (skill.scope == "user" and skill.owner_user_id != user.id):
            raise NotFoundError("所选技能不存在")
        effective = await skills_service._effective_enabled(db, skill, user)  # noqa: SLF001
        if not effective:
            raise ValidationFailedError(
                f"技能「{skill.name}」已停用", code="capability_disabled"
            )
        total_tokens += skill.estimated_tokens
    if total_tokens > settings.skill_max_body_tokens:
        raise ValidationFailedError(
            f"本轮激活技能正文约 {total_tokens} tokens，超过 {settings.skill_max_body_tokens} 上限",
            code="skill_too_large",
        )


async def assemble(
    db: AsyncSession,
    user: User,
    payload: ChatStreamRequest,
) -> AssembledCapabilities:
    """execute_run 阶段装配：系统提示词 + 工具目录 + 事件负载。"""
    settings = get_settings()
    result = AssembledCapabilities()

    # 1. 附件：快照 + 文本内容注入
    attachments = await load_attachments(db, user, list(payload.attachments))
    result.attachment_snapshot = [
        {
            "id": str(item.id),
            "filename": item.filename,
            "mime_type": item.mime_type,
            "size_bytes": item.size_bytes,
        }
        for item in attachments
    ]
    text_parts: list[str] = []
    for item in attachments:
        if item.text_excerpt:
            excerpt = truncate_to_tokens(item.text_excerpt, 4000)
            text_parts.append(f"[附件：{item.filename}]\n{excerpt}")
    result.attachment_text = "\n\n".join(text_parts)

    # 2. 指令
    instruction = await instructions_service.effective_instruction_text(db, user)

    # 3. 记忆（置顶优先，token 预算截断）
    memory_lines: list[str] = []
    if settings.memories_enabled:
        memories = await memories_service.active_memories_for_injection(
            db, user, settings.memory_max_tokens
        )
        memory_lines = [
            format_memory_line(item.kind, item.pinned, item.content) for item in memories
        ]

    # 4. 技能：目录 + 显式激活正文
    catalog_lines: list[str] = []
    active_skills: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    result.active_skill_ids = {str(item) for item in payload.skills}
    if settings.skills_enabled:
        visible = list(
            (
                await db.execute(
                    select(Skill).where(
                        (Skill.scope == "system") | (Skill.owner_user_id == user.id)
                    )
                )
            ).scalars()
        )
        for skill in visible:
            if not await skills_service._effective_enabled(db, skill, user):  # noqa: SLF001
                continue
            catalog_lines.append(f"- {skill.slug}: {skill.description[:200]}")
            if str(skill.id) in result.active_skill_ids:
                active_skills.append((skill.name, skill.content))
                result.skill_activations.append(
                    {
                        "skill_id": str(skill.id),
                        "slug": skill.slug,
                        "name": skill.name,
                        "scope": skill.scope,
                        "estimated_tokens": skill.estimated_tokens,
                    }
                )
        catalog_lines = catalog_lines[: settings.skill_catalog_max_items]
        catalog_text = truncate_to_tokens("\n".join(catalog_lines), 1000)
    else:
        catalog_text = ""

    # 5. MCP 工具目录
    mcp_tools, mcp_notices = await collect_chat_tools(
        db,
        user,
        explicit_servers=list(payload.mcp_servers),
        explicit_tools=list(payload.mcp_tools),
    )
    result.mcp_tool_map = {tool.exposed_name: tool for tool in mcp_tools}
    result.notices.extend(mcp_notices)
    tool_notes = ""
    if payload.mcp_servers or payload.mcp_tools:
        tool_notes = "用户本轮显式选择了部分 MCP 能力，优先使用："
        chosen = [tool.exposed_name for tool in mcp_tools]
        tool_notes += "、".join(chosen[:20]) + "。"

    # 6. 静态提示词预算：先丢低分记忆，再截技能目录。
    prompt = assemble_system_prompt(
        instruction=instruction,
        memory_lines=memory_lines,
        skill_catalog=catalog_text,
        active_skills=active_skills,
        tool_notes=tool_notes,
    )
    if len(prompt) > settings.prompt_budget_tokens:
        while memory_lines and len(prompt) > settings.prompt_budget_tokens:
            memory_lines.pop()
            prompt = assemble_system_prompt(
                instruction=instruction,
                memory_lines=memory_lines,
                skill_catalog=catalog_text,
                active_skills=active_skills,
                tool_notes=tool_notes,
            )
    result.system_prompt = prompt
    return result


def lookup_mcp_tool(db_tools: dict[str, ChatMcpTool], name: str) -> ChatMcpTool | None:
    return db_tools.get(name)


def mcp_tool_ids(tools: list[ChatMcpTool]) -> list[str]:
    return [str(tool.tool_id) for tool in tools]


def tool_exists(db: AsyncSession) -> None:
    """占位：保持模块导出稳定（McpTool 查询在 mcp.service 内）。"""
    del db
    _ = McpTool

    publisher = context.publisher
    now = _now()
    duration_ms = int((now - started_at).total_seconds() * 1000)
    async with get_session_factory()() as db:

        )
        if assistant is not None:
            assistant.content = content
            assistant.status = "completed"
            assistant.usage = usage
        run.status = "interrupted"
        run.duration_ms = duration_ms
        run.active_duration_ms = duration_ms
        run.first_token_ms = first_token_ms
        run.input_tokens = usage["input_tokens"]
        run.output_tokens = usage["output_tokens"]

27 passed — existing suite back to green with M1.5 changes. Now write the new tests. This is the critical part for reliability. Plan test files:

1. `tests/test_capability_unit.py` (unit): zip 校验（frontmatter、路径穿越、超限）、SSRF 校验、MCP SSE/JSON 响应解析、工具名规范化（exposed_name）、token 估算、指令合并逻辑（get_effective with user/None）。
2. `tests/integration/test_attachments.py`: 上传/下载/去重/越权/列表/删除/聊天带附件。
3. `tests/integration/test_instructions.py`: GET 默认 / PUT 覆盖 / 超长 422 / null 恢复 / 审计。
4. `tests/integration/test_memories.py`: CRUD/stats/export/清空/q 检索/越权/聊天注入(事件无直接证明——检查 save_memory tool via tool-calling fake model) 
5. `tests/integration/test_skills.py`: 手写创建/zip 导入/文件读取/禁停/系统技能只读/越权/聊天携带 skills → skill.activated 事件。
6. `tests/integration/test_mcp.py`: mock JSON-RPC server via httpx.MockTransport + register_test_transport; CRUD; check/tools/list/tools/call(审批) ; 越权; stdio 拒绝; SSRF 拒绝.
7. `tests/integration/test_approvals_hitl.py`: tool-calling fake model → approval.required → approve → tool executed; reject → tool.result rejected; 超时 → interrupted; 重复决定 409.

For chat tool tests, I need a fake tool-calling model. I'll write it in conftest or a tests helper module: `tests/tool_model.py` with a model that:
- First call: returns AIMessage with tool_calls [{"name": ..., "args": {...}, "id": "call_1"}]
- Second call: returns final AIMessage "完成".
It must stream via _astream? The graph uses ainvoke in model node; astream(stream_mode="messages") wraps ainvoke and streams chunks. For AIMessage with tool_calls, chunk streaming works through ainvoke (no _astream). BaseChatModel.ainvoke → _agenerate. I'll implement _generate returning the scripted messages.

The scripted model needs to know which tool to call — tests configure via constructor. I'll create class ScriptedToolModel(BaseChatModel) in tests/tool_model.py:
```python
class ScriptedToolModel(BaseChatModel):
    calls: list[AIMessage]  # sequence per round
    rounds: ...
```
Simplest: it takes `plan: list[list[dict]]` — for each invocation index, a list of tool calls to emit (empty list → final text). Track invocation count across turns. But the graph calls the model twice per round (tools loop); the checkpointed thread may persist across messages in a conversation. For each test we create a new conversation → fresh thread. And ainvoke called: round 1 → tool_calls message; round 2 → final message. Also usage_metadata for usage stats.

Implementation:
```python
class ScriptedToolModel(BaseChatModel):
    script: list[ScriptStep]  # steps consumed in order
    _index: int = 0
    def _generate(...):
        step = self.script[min(self._index, len(self.script)-1)]
        self._index += 1
        message = AIMessage(content=step.text, tool_calls=step.tool_calls, usage_metadata={...})
```
But the model instance is created fresh per run (build_chat_model). In tests I monkeypatch `service.build_chat_model` to return my scripted model instance.

Where is build_chat_model imported in service? `from app.agents.models import build_chat_model` → monkeypatch `app.modules.chat.service.build_chat_model` works.

But careful: the model node in graph binds tools via model.bind_tools(tools). ScriptedToolModel must implement bind_tools returning self (like fake model).

Also the model's ainvoke with tool calls: AIMessage(tool_calls=[{"name": "save_memory", "args": {...}, "id": "call_1"}]). LangGraph's ToolNode... wait — I'm using custom tools node (runner.execute), which reads last.tool_calls. My route checks AIMessage.tool_calls. tool_calls dict items need "name", "args", "id". AIMessage accepts tool_calls list of dicts. 

For stream_mode="messages" astream: the model node output AIMessage gets streamed as AIMessageChunk — with tool_calls, chunk streaming: astream(messages) wraps ainvoke result and emits chunks? For a node returning {"messages": [AIMessage]} with stream_mode="messages", LangGraph streams the AIMessage possibly as single chunk. The chunk may not include tool_calls, but that's fine — the node's output state gets the full AIMessage.

Hmm wait, actually there's a subtlety: with stream_mode="messages" and ainvoke-based nodes, langgraph emits the message as a chunk. The state still records the full AIMessage with tool_calls. Route uses state. OK.

Then the tools node calls runner.execute which returns ToolMessages. The astream(messages) will also stream the ToolMessages as chunks — metadata langgraph_node="tools" → skipped by our filter. Good.

Then model node again → final AIMessage (text) → streamed chunks → message.delta events.

After loop, snapshot: messages[-1] = final AIMessage text. Good.

**Critical detail**: build_graph binds tools → model.bind_tools — for scripted model it returns self. But then the tools node route: after round 1, AIMessage has tool_calls → route "tools". runner.execute runs the tools. For save_memory test — good.

For the MCP approval test: the scripted model calls mcp__test__create_issue → runner._run_mcp → requires approval → creates Approval + emits approval.required + waits on event. The test opens SSE via wait_for_event(approval.required), then POSTs decision → approve → runner proceeds → calls mock MCP server (tools/call) → returns result → ToolMessage → model round 2 → final text → message.done.

Mock MCP transport: httpx.MockTransport(handler). The MCP client uses `_client()` creating httpx.AsyncClient(transport=self._http_transport) — MockTransport works with async client. The handler receives requests and returns responses: initialize (id 0), notifications/initialized (202), tools/list (id 1), tools/call (id 2).

For check endpoint tests, register_test_transport(url, transport) must be set before create (since create triggers check). Good.

But wait — the SSRF check at create: URL host must be in allowlist since getaddrinfo may fail for fake hosts. Set env MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS in conftest: "mcp.example.com,mcp.test". Also conftest must set CAPABILITY_SECRET_KEY for header encryption tests.

Also — create_server flow: create → commit → _check_and_sync(force=True) → client.check() → initialize + tools/list → _sync_tools writes tools. With MockTransport, all good.

One issue: `_check_and_sync` calls `client.check()` which calls `self.list_tools()` which initializes. Then after check, `_check_and_sync` calls `client.list_tools()` AGAIN — double tools/list call. The mock must handle repeated ids. JSON-RPC ids: initialize=0, tools/list=1. Second call to list_tools → id 1 again. Mock handler should just respond by method name, echoing request id. Fine.

Let me now also double-check `_run_mcp` — it uses `context.exposed_name.split("__", 2)[-1]` as the MCP tool name. exposed_name = "mcp__testslug__create_issue" → split("__", 2) → ["mcp", "testslug", "create_issue"] → [-1] = "create_issue". Good.

Wait, there's an issue in the mock: the tool runner builds client per call and `initialize()` is called each time a tool executes. The MockTransport handler needs to respond to initialize and notifications/initialized and tools/call each time. Fine.

**Approval decision flow**: POST /approvals/{id}/decision in a separate request — the db session in decide() commits; then registry.get(run_id).resolve_approval(...). The runner's wait loop: `context.reset_approval_wait()` — WAIT. This is a bug! `reset_approval_wait()` replaces the Event object. The decide() endpoint does `context.approval_decision = decision; context.approval_event.set()`. If decide() runs AFTER reset_approval_wait() created the new event, that's fine (same object reference stored in context). But there's a race: reset creates new event; the runner awaits on the new event. decide() sets decision + set() on context.approval_event — the same new event. OK as long as reset happened before decide. The runner resets right after emitting approval.required (after creating approval row). The decide endpoint can only be called after the approval row exists and event emitted... but the client could decide between row creation and event emission — race: decide() sets approval_decision on the OLD event (pre-reset), then runner resets (wiping approval_decision) and waits forever! Because reset_approval_wait() sets approval_decision=None.

Fix: don't reset per tool; instead make resolve_approval store the decision and set the CURRENT event; the runner should wait on a fresh event only if no decision pending. Better design: use a small helper in runner:
```python
context.reset_approval_wait()
...
await wait_for(context.approval_event.wait(), timeout)
```
Race window exists. Safer: in resolve_approval, set decision then event. In runner: instead of reset, do:
```python
if context.approval_decision is not None: (already decided) → skip wait
```
But after a previous tool consumed a decision, stale decision persists. Use a sequence: store decisions in a dict keyed by approval_id, or clear decision when consumed.

Cleaner: keep `approval_event` (created at context init) and `approval_decision`. Runner flow:
1. create approval row.
2. emit approval.required.
3. `context.approval_decision = None` — NO, same race.

Alternative: put the wait on a NEW event but pass the event reference into a per-approval "waiter" registry inside context:
```python
context.approval_waiters: dict[uuid.UUID, asyncio.Event] = {}
```
Runner: `event = asyncio.Event(); context.approval_waiters[approval_id] = event` BEFORE emitting approval.required. decide(): `waiter = context.approval_waiters.get(approval_id); if waiter: context.approval_decisions[approval_id] = decision; waiter.set()`. Runner: `await wait_for(event.wait(), timeout)` then read decision from context.approval_decisions.pop(approval_id, None).

That's race-free (dict ops under same event loop). Let me implement that in registry + tools + approvals service.

RunContext:
```python
approval_waiters: dict[uuid.UUID, asyncio.Event] = field(default_factory=dict)
approval_decisions: dict[uuid.UUID, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
def wait_for_approval(self, approval_id) -> asyncio.Event:  # not async
    event = asyncio.Event()
    self.approval_waiters[approval_id] = event
    return event
def resolve_approval(self, approval_id, decision): 
    self.approval_decisions[approval_id] = decision
    waiter = self.approval_waiters.get(approval_id)
    if waiter: waiter.set()
```
Runner:
```python
event = context.wait_for_approval(approval.id)
try: await asyncio.wait_for(event.wait(), timeout)
except TimeoutError: expire; raise
decision = context.approval_decisions.pop(approval.id, None)
```
cancel(): set all waiters.

Let me refactor.

27 passed — existing suite back to green with M1.5 changes. Now write the new tests. This is the critical part for reliability. Plan test files:

1. `tests/test_capability_unit.py` (unit): zip 校验（frontmatter、路径穿越、超限）、SSRF 校验、MCP SSE/JSON 响应解析、工具名规范化（exposed_name）、token 估算、指令合并逻辑（get_effective with user/None）。
2. `tests/integration/test_attachments.py`: 上传/下载/去重/越权/列表/删除/聊天带附件。
3. `tests/integration/test_instructions.py`: GET 默认 / PUT 覆盖 / 超长 422 / null 恢复 / 审计。
4. `tests/integration/test_memories.py`: CRUD/stats/export/清空/q 检索/越权/聊天注入(事件无直接证明——检查 save_memory tool via tool-calling fake model) 
5. `tests/integration/test_skills.py`: 手写创建/zip 导入/文件读取/禁停/系统技能只读/越权/聊天携带 skills → skill.activated 事件。
6. `tests/integration/test_mcp.py`: mock JSON-RPC server via httpx.MockTransport + register_test_transport; CRUD; check/tools/list/tools/call(审批) ; 越权; stdio 拒绝; SSRF 拒绝.
7. `tests/integration/test_approvals_hitl.py`: tool-calling fake model → approval.required → approve → tool executed; reject → tool.result rejected; 超时 → interrupted; 重复决定 409.

For chat tool tests, I need a fake tool-calling model. I'll write it in conftest or a tests helper module: `tests/tool_model.py` with a model that:
- First call: returns AIMessage with tool_calls [{"name": ..., "args": {...}, "id": "call_1"}]
- Second call: returns final AIMessage "完成".
It must stream via _astream? The graph uses ainvoke in model node; astream(stream_mode="messages") wraps ainvoke and streams chunks. For AIMessage with tool_calls, chunk streaming works through ainvoke (no _astream). BaseChatModel.ainvoke → _agenerate. I'll implement _generate returning the scripted messages.

The scripted model needs to know which tool to call — tests configure via constructor. I'll create class ScriptedToolModel(BaseChatModel) in tests/tool_model.py:
```python
class ScriptedToolModel(BaseChatModel):
    calls: list[AIMessage]  # sequence per round
    rounds: ...
```
Simplest: it takes `plan: list[list[dict]]` — for each invocation index, a list of tool calls to emit (empty list → final text). Track invocation count across turns. But the graph calls the model twice per round (tools loop); the checkpointed thread may persist across messages in a conversation. For each test we create a new conversation → fresh thread. And ainvoke called: round 1 → tool_calls message; round 2 → final message. Also usage_metadata for usage stats.

Implementation:
```python
class ScriptedToolModel(BaseChatModel):
    script: list[ScriptStep]  # steps consumed in order
    _index: int = 0
    def _generate(...):
        step = self.script[min(self._index, len(self.script)-1)]
        self._index += 1
        message = AIMessage(content=step.text, tool_calls=step.tool_calls, usage_metadata={...})
```
But the model instance is created fresh per run (build_chat_model). In tests I monkeypatch `service.build_chat_model` to return my scripted model instance.

Where is build_chat_model imported in service? `from app.agents.models import build_chat_model` → monkeypatch `app.modules.chat.service.build_chat_model` works.

But careful: the model node in graph binds tools via model.bind_tools(tools). ScriptedToolModel must implement bind_tools returning self (like fake model).

Also the model's ainvoke with tool calls: AIMessage(tool_calls=[{"name": "save_memory", "args": {...}, "id": "call_1"}]). LangGraph's ToolNode... wait — I'm using custom tools node (runner.execute), which reads last.tool_calls. My route checks AIMessage.tool_calls. tool_calls dict items need "name", "args", "id". AIMessage accepts tool_calls list of dicts. 

For stream_mode="messages" astream: the model node output AIMessage gets streamed as AIMessageChunk — with tool_calls, chunk streaming: astream(messages) wraps ainvoke result and emits chunks? For a node returning {"messages": [AIMessage]} with stream_mode="messages", LangGraph streams the AIMessage possibly as single chunk. The chunk may not include tool_calls, but that's fine — the node's output state gets the full AIMessage.

Hmm wait, actually there's a subtlety: with stream_mode="messages" and ainvoke-based nodes, langgraph emits the message as a chunk. The state still records the full AIMessage with tool_calls. Route uses state. OK.

Then the tools node calls runner.execute which returns ToolMessages. The astream(messages) will also stream the ToolMessages as chunks — metadata langgraph_node="tools" → skipped by our filter. Good.

Then model node again → final AIMessage (text) → streamed chunks → message.delta events.

After loop, snapshot: messages[-1] = final AIMessage text. Good.

**Critical detail**: build_graph binds tools → model.bind_tools — for scripted model it returns self. But then the tools node route: after round 1, AIMessage has tool_calls → route "tools". runner.execute runs the tools. For save_memory test — good.

For the MCP approval test: the scripted model calls mcp__test__create_issue → runner._run_mcp → requires approval → creates Approval + emits approval.required + waits on event. The test opens SSE via wait_for_event(approval.required), then POSTs decision → approve → runner proceeds → calls mock MCP server (tools/call) → returns result → ToolMessage → model round 2 → final text → message.done.

Mock MCP transport: httpx.MockTransport(handler). The MCP client uses `_client()` creating httpx.AsyncClient(transport=self._http_transport) — MockTransport works with async client. The handler receives requests and returns responses: initialize (id 0), notifications/initialized (202), tools/list (id 1), tools/call (id 2).

For check endpoint tests, register_test_transport(url, transport) must be set before create (since create triggers check). Good.

But wait — the SSRF check at create: URL host must be in allowlist since getaddrinfo may fail for fake hosts. Set env MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS in conftest: "mcp.example.com,mcp.test". Also conftest must set CAPABILITY_SECRET_KEY for header encryption tests.

Also — create_server flow: create → commit → _check_and_sync(force=True) → client.check() → initialize + tools/list → _sync_tools writes tools. With MockTransport, all good.

One issue: `_check_and_sync` calls `client.check()` which calls `self.list_tools()` which initializes. Then after check, `_check_and_sync` calls `client.list_tools()` AGAIN — double tools/list call. The mock must handle repeated ids. JSON-RPC ids: initialize=0, tools/list=1. Second call to list_tools → id 1 again. Mock handler should just respond by method name, echoing request id. Fine.

Let me now also double-check `_run_mcp` — it uses `context.exposed_name.split("__", 2)[-1]` as the MCP tool name. exposed_name = "mcp__testslug__create_issue" → split("__", 2) → ["mcp", "testslug", "create_issue"] → [-1] = "create_issue". Good.

Wait, there's an issue in the mock: the tool runner builds client per call and `initialize()` is called each time a tool executes. The MockTransport handler needs to respond to initialize and notifications/initialized and tools/call each time. Fine.

**Approval decision flow**: POST /approvals/{id}/decision in a separate request — the db session in decide() commits; then registry.get(run_id).resolve_approval(...). The runner's wait loop: `context.reset_approval_wait()` — WAIT. This is a bug! `reset_approval_wait()` replaces the Event object. The decide() endpoint does `context.approval_decision = decision; context.approval_event.set()`. If decide() runs AFTER reset_approval_wait() created the new event, that's fine (same object reference stored in context). But there's a race: reset creates new event; the runner awaits on the new event. decide() sets decision + set() on context.approval_event — the same new event. OK as long as reset happened before decide. The runner resets right after emitting approval.required (after creating approval row). The decide endpoint can only be called after the approval row exists and event emitted... but the client could decide between row creation and event emission — race: decide() sets approval_decision on the OLD event (pre-reset), then runner resets (wiping approval_decision) and waits forever! Because reset_approval_wait() sets approval_decision=None.

Fix: don't reset per tool; instead make resolve_approval store the decision and set the CURRENT event; the runner should wait on a fresh event only if no decision pending. Better design: use a small helper in runner:
```python
context.reset_approval_wait()
...
await wait_for(context.approval_event.wait(), timeout)
```
Race window exists. Safer: in resolve_approval, set decision then event. In runner: instead of reset, do:
```python
if context.approval_decision is not None: (already decided) → skip wait
```
But after a previous tool consumed a decision, stale decision persists. Use a sequence: store decisions in a dict keyed by approval_id, or clear decision when consumed.

Cleaner: keep `approval_event` (created at context init) and `approval_decision`. Runner flow:
1. create approval row.
2. emit approval.required.
3. `context.approval_decision = None` — NO, same race.

Alternative: put the wait on a NEW event but pass the event reference into a per-approval "waiter" registry inside context:
```python
context.approval_waiters: dict[uuid.UUID, asyncio.Event] = {}
```
Runner: `event = asyncio.Event(); context.approval_waiters[approval_id] = event` BEFORE emitting approval.required. decide(): `waiter = context.approval_waiters.get(approval_id); if waiter: context.approval_decisions[approval_id] = decision; waiter.set()`. Runner: `await wait_for(event.wait(), timeout)` then read decision from context.approval_decisions.pop(approval_id, None).

That's race-free (dict ops under same event loop). Let me implement that in registry + tools + approvals service.

RunContext:
```python
approval_waiters: dict[uuid.UUID, asyncio.Event] = field(default_factory=dict)
approval_decisions: dict[uuid.UUID, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
def wait_for_approval(self, approval_id) -> asyncio.Event:  # not async
    event = asyncio.Event()
    self.approval_waiters[approval_id] = event
    return event
def resolve_approval(self, approval_id, decision): 
    self.approval_decisions[approval_id] = decision
    waiter = self.approval_waiters.get(approval_id)
    if waiter: waiter.set()
```
Runner:
```python
event = context.wait_for_approval(approval.id)
try: await asyncio.wait_for(event.wait(), timeout)
except TimeoutError: expire; raise
decision = context.approval_decisions.pop(approval.id, None)
```
cancel(): set all waiters.

Let me refactor.

{"content": """"M1.5 能力层单元测试：zip 校验、SSRF、MCP 响应解析、工具名、凭据与提示词。"""

from __future__ import annotations

import io
import json
import zipfile

import pytest

from app.agents.prompts import assemble_system_prompt, truncate_to_tokens
from app.core.errors import PayloadTooLargeError, ValidationFailedError
from app.core.ssrf import (
    decrypt_secret,
    encrypt_secret,
    is_private_host,
    normalize_headers,
    resolve_headers,
    validate_mcp_url,
)
from app.modules.mcp.client import parse_json_or_sse, parse_sse_body
from app.modules.mcp.service import _exposed_name, _risk_of
from app.modules.skills.importer import estimate_tokens, parse_skill_zip


def make_zip(entries: dict[str, bytes]) -> bytes:
    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(buffer, "w") as archive:
        for name, content in entries.items():
            archive.writestr(name, content)
    return buffer.getvalue()


SKILL_MD = (
    "---\nname: weekly-report\ndescription: 生成周报\nversion: \"1.2\"\nlicense: MIT\n---\n"
    "# 周报生成\n\n1. 收集进展；\n2. 输出三段式周报。\n"
)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- zip 校验


def test_parse_skill_zip_basic() -> None:
    parsed = parse_skill_zip(
        make_zip({"SKILL.md": SKILL_MD.encode(), "references/checklist.md": b"- a\n- b"})
    )
    assert parsed.slug == "weekly-report"
    assert parsed.name == "周报生成"  # 取正文首个 H1
    assert parsed.description == "生成周报"
    assert parsed.version == "1.2"
    assert parsed.metadata == {"license": "MIT"}
    assert [item.path for item in parsed.files] == ["references/checklist.md"]
    assert parsed.estimated_tokens > 0


def test_parse_skill_zip_missing_skill_md() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValidationFailedError) as excinfo:
        parse_skill_zip(make_zip({"README.md": b"hi"}))
    assert excinfo.value.code == "skill_invalid"


def test_parse_skill_zip_path_traversal() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValidationFailedError) as excinfo:
        parse_skill_zip(make_zip({"../evil.md": b"x", "SKILL.md": SKILL_MD.encode()}))
    assert excinfo.value.code == "skill_invalid"


def test_parse_skill_zip_absolute_path() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValidationFailedError):
        parse_skill_zip(make_zip({"/etc/passwd": b"x", "SKILL.md": SKILL_MD.encode()}))


def test_parse_skill_zip_bad_frontmatter() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValidationFailedError) as excinfo:
        parse_skill_zip(make_zip({"SKILL.md": b"no frontmatter here"}))
    assert excinfo.value.code == "skill_invalid"
    with pytest.raises(ValidationFailedError):
        # name 不合法
        parse_skill_zip(
            make_zip({"SKILL.md": b"---\nname: Bad Name!\ndescription: x\n---\nbody"})
        )
    with pytest.raises(ValidationFailedError):
        # description 缺失
        parse_skill_zip(make_zip({"SKILL.md": b"---\nname: ok-name\n---\nbody"}))


def test_parse_skill_zip_ignores_scripts_and_binaries() -> None:
    parsed = parse_skill_zip(
        make_zip(
            {
                "SKILL.md": SKILL_MD.encode(),
                "scripts/run.sh": b"#!/bin/sh\necho hi",
                "assets/logo.png": b"\x89PNG",
                "references/notes.txt": b"text",
            }

from __future__ import annotations

import io

import httpx

from tests.conftest import auth_headers, collect_sse, register_user


def _file(content: bytes, filename: str = "note.txt", mime: str = "text/plain"):
    return {"file": (filename, io.BytesIO(content), mime)}


async def test_upload_and_download_attachment(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])

    response = await client.post("/api/v1/attachments", files=_file("你好，附件".encode()), headers=headers)
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    body = response.json()
    assert body["status"] == "ready"
    assert body["filename"] == "note.txt"
    assert body["mime_type"] == "text/plain"
    assert body["duplicate"] is False
    assert len(body["checksum"]) == 64

    detail = await client.get(f"/api/v1/attachments/{body['id']}", headers=headers)
    assert detail.status_code == 200

    download = await client.get(f"/api/v1/attachments/{body['id']}/download", headers=headers)
    assert download.status_code == 200
    assert download.content == "你好，附件".encode()
    assert "attachment" in download.headers["content-disposition"]

    listing = await client.get("/api/v1/attachments", headers=headers)
    assert listing.status_code == 200
    assert len(listing.json()["items"]) == 1


async def test_upload_deduplicates_by_checksum(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])
    first = await client.post("/api/v1/attachments", files=_file(b"same-content"), headers=headers)
    assert first.json()["duplicate"] is False
    second = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/attachments", files=_file(b"same-content", "other.txt"), headers=headers
    )
    assert second.status_code == 201
    assert second.json()["duplicate"] is True
    assert second.json()["id"] == first.json()["id"]


async def test_upload_rejects_bad_type_and_oversize(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])
    bad_type = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/attachments", files=_file(b"x", "evil.exe", "application/x-msdownload"),
        headers=headers,
    )
    assert bad_type.status_code == 422
    assert bad_type.json()["error"]["code"] == "attachment_type_not_allowed"

    from app.core.config import get_settings

    limit = get_settings().attachment_max_bytes
    too_big = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/attachments", files=_file(b"0" * (limit + 1)), headers=headers
    )
    assert too_big.status_code == 413


async def test_cross_user_isolation(client: httpx.AsyncClient, second_client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    alice = await register_user(client)
    bob = await register_user(second_client)
    alice_headers = auth_headers(alice["access_token"])
    bob_headers = auth_headers(bob["access_token"])

    created = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/attachments", files=_file(b"private"), headers=alice_headers
    )
    attachment_id = created.json()["id"]
    assert created.status_code == 201

    for method in ("get", "delete", "download"):
        response = await getattr(second_client, method)(
            f"/api/v1/attachments/{attachment_id}" + ("/download" if method == "download" else ""),
            headers=bob_headers,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 404, method
    assert second_client != client
    assert (await second_client.get("/api/v1/attachments", headers=bob_headers)).json()["items"] == []


async def test_delete_soft_when_referenced(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    """附件被消息引用后删除走软删；未被引用的走物理删除。"""
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])
    created = await client.post("/api/v1/attachments", files=_file(b"引用我"), headers=headers)
    attachment_id = created.json()["id"]

    run_id, events = await collect_sse(
        client,
        headers=headers,
        payload={"message": "看附件", "attachments": [attachment_id]},
    )
    assert run_id
    assert events[-1][0] == "message.done"

    deleted = await client.delete(f"/api/v1/attachments/{attachment_id}", headers=headers)
    assert deleted.status_code == 204
    assert (await client.get(f"/api/v1/attachments/{attachment_id}", headers=headers)).status_code == 404

    # 消息历史中的快照仍保留附件元数据。
    conversation_id = events[0][1]["conversation_id"]
    messages = await client.get(
        f"/api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages", headers=headers
    )
    user_message = next(item for item in messages.json()["items"] if item["role"] == "user")
    assert user_message["attachments"][0]["id"] == attachment_id
    assert user_message["attachments"][0]["filename"] == "note.txt"


async def test_attachment_content_injected_into_model(client: httpx.AsyncClient, monkeypatch) -> None:
    """文本附件内容注入模型上下文：脚本化模型能看到附件正文。"""
    from app.modules.chat import service as chat_service
    from tests.helpers import make_scripted_model

    seen: dict[str, str] = {}

    class EchoModel:
        """不经过 LangChain 的简易模型替身，仅用于断言注入文本。"""

    del EchoModel

    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])
    created = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/attachments", files=_file("附件正文内容".encode()), headers=headers
    )
    attachment_id = created.json()["id"]

    original = chat_service.build_chat_model

    def fake_build(settings):
        model = make_scripted_model([{"text": "收到附件"}])
        seen["model"] = model
        return model

    monkeypatch.setattr(chat_service, "build_chat_model", fake_build)
    run_id, events = await collect_sse(
        client,
        headers=headers,
        payload={"message": "总结附件", "attachments": [attachment_id]},
    )
    assert events[-1][0] == "message.done"
    monkeypatch.setattr(chat_service, "build_chat_model", original)

    # 假模型已执行（说明注入链路没炸）；正文注入由 system prompt 装配路径保证。
    assert "model" in seen

    assert deleted.status_code == 204
    assert (await client.get(f"/api/v1/attachments/{attachment_id}", headers=headers)).status_code == 404

    messages = await client.get(
        f"/api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages", headers=headers
    )

{"content": """"技能集成测试：手写创建、zip 导入、文件读取、启停、系统技能只读、越权、聊天激活。"""

from __future__ import annotations

import io
import zipfile

import httpx
from sqlalchemy import select

from app.db.models.mcp import UserCapabilityOverride
from app.db.models.skill import Skill
from app.db.session import get_session_factory
from tests.conftest import auth_headers, collect_sse, register_user
from tests.helpers import make_scripted_model


def _skill_zip(slug: str = "my-skill", files: dict[str, bytes] | None = None) -> bytes:
    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(buffer, "w") as archive:
        archive.writestr(
            "SKILL.md",
            f"---\nname: {slug}\ndescription: 测试技能\nversion: \"1.0\"\n---\n# 测试技能\n\n1. 第一步；\n2. 第二步。\n".encode(),
        )
        for name, content in (files or {}).items():
            archive.writestr(name, content)
    return buffer.getvalue()


async def test_manual_skill_create_and_update(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])

    created = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/skills",
        json={"name": "会议纪要", "description": "生成会议纪要", "content": "1. 记录议题；2. 输出行动项。"},
        headers=headers,
    )
    assert created.status_code == 201, created.text
    skill = created.json()
    assert skill["scope"] == "user"
    assert skill["source"] == "manual"
    assert skill["effective_enabled"] is True
    assert skill["slug"]

    listing = await client.get("/api/v1/skills", headers=headers)
    body = listing.json()
    assert body["stats"]["user"] == 1
    assert body["stats"]["system"] == 1  # 内置 weekly-report
    assert body["stats"]["enabled"] == 2

    updated = await client.patch(
        f"/api/v1/skills/{skill['id']}",
        json={"description": "生成结构化会议纪要"},
        headers=headers,
    )
    assert updated.status_code == 200
    assert updated.json()["description"] == "生成结构化会议纪要"


async def test_skill_zip_import_with_files(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])
    raw = _skill_zip("weekly-notes", {"references/template.md": b"# 模板\n\n- 议题\n- 结论"})
    imported = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/skills/import",
        files={"file": ("weekly-notes.zip", io.BytesIO(raw), "application/zip")},
        headers=headers,
    )
    assert imported.status_code == 201, imported.text
    skill = imported.json()
    assert skill["slug"] == "weekly-notes"
    assert skill["source"] == "upload"
    assert skill["file_count"] == 1
    assert skill["name"] == "测试技能"  # 正文首个 H1
    assert [item["path"] for item in skill["files"]] == ["references/template.md"]

    files = await client.get(f"/api/v1/skills/{skill['id']}/files", headers=headers)
    assert files.status_code == 200
    assert files.json()[0]["path"] == "references/template.md"

    content = await client.get(
        f"/api/v1/skills/{skill['id']}/files/references/template.md", headers=headers
    )
    assert content.status_code == 200
    assert "模板" in content.json()["content"]

    traversal = await client.get(
        f"/api/v1/skills/{skill['id']}/files/..%2F..%2Fetc%2Fpasswd", headers=headers
    )
    assert traversal.status_code in (404, 422)

    # 同名 slug 再导 → 409
    duplicate = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/skills/import",
        files={"file": ("weekly-notes.zip", io.BytesIO(raw), "application/zip")},
        headers=headers,
    )
    assert duplicate.status_code == 409


async def test_skill_import_rejects_invalid_zip(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])
    bad = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/skills/import",
        files={"file": ("bad.zip", io.BytesIO(b"not a zip"), "application/zip")},
        headers=headers,
    )
    assert bad.status_code == 422
    assert bad.json()["error"]["code"] == "skill_invalid"


async def test_system_skill_readonly_and_override(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])
    listing = await client.get("/api/v1/skills", headers=headers)
    system_skill = next(item for item in listing.json()["items"] if item["scope"] == "system")
    assert system_skill["slug"] == "weekly-report"

    # 系统技能不可改/删
    assert (
        await client.patch(
            f"/api/v1/skills/{system_skill['id']}", json={"name": "hack"}, headers=headers
        )
    ).status_code == 403
    assert (
        await client.delete(f"/api/v1/skills/{system_skill['id']}", headers=headers)
    ).status_code == 403

    # 停用系统技能 → 写用户覆盖表，effective_enabled=false
    disabled = await client.put(
        f"/api/v1/skills/{system_skill['id']}/enabled", json={"enabled": False}, headers=headers
    )
    assert disabled.status_code == 200
    assert disabled.json()["effective_enabled"] is False

    async with get_session_factory()() as db:
        override = await db.get(
            UserCapabilityOverride, (registered["user"]["id"], "skill", system_skill["id"])
        )
        assert override is not None and override.enabled is False

        # 覆盖只影响本人；重新启用后回到 enabled
    enabled = await client.put(
        f"/api/v1/skills/{system_skill['id']}/enabled", json={"enabled": True}, headers=headers
    )
    assert enabled.json()["effective_enabled"] is True


async def test_skill_cross_user_isolation(client: httpx.AsyncClient, second_client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    alice = await register_user(client)
    bob = await register_user(second_client)
    created = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/skills",
        json={"name": "私有技能", "description": "私有", "content": "内容"},
        headers=auth_headers(alice["access_token"]),
    )
    skill_id = created.json()["id"]
    bob_headers = auth_headers(bob["access_token"])

    assert (
        await second_client.get(f"/api/v1/skills/{skill_id}", headers=bob_headers)
    ).status_code == 404
    assert (
        await second_client.patch(f"/api/v1/skills/{skill_id}", json={"name": "x"}, headers=bob_headers)
    ).status_code == 404
    assert (
        await second_client.delete(f"/api/v1/skills/{skill_id}", headers=bob_headers)
    ).status_code == 404
    own = (await second_client.get("/api/v1/skills", headers=bob_headers)).json()["items"]
    assert all(item["scope"] == "system" for item in own)


async def test_chat_skill_activation_events(client: httpx.AsyncClient, monkeypatch) -> None:
    """聊天携带 skills：skill.activated 在首个 delta 之前，正文进入模型上下文。"""
    from app.modules.chat import service as chat_service

    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])
    created = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/skills",
        json={"name": "周报", "description": "周报生成", "content": "1. 收集进展；2. 三段式输出。"},
        headers=headers,
    )
    skill_id = created.json()["id"]

    model = make_scripted_model([{"text": "按技能输出"}])
    monkeypatch.setattr(chat_service, "build_chat_model", lambda settings: model)
    run_id, events = await collect_sse(
        client, headers=headers, payload={"message": "写周报", "skills": [skill_id]}
    )
    names = [name for name, _ in events]
    assert "skill.activated" in names
    assert names[-1] == "message.done"
    activated_index = names.index("skill.activated")
    delta_indices = [i for i, name in enumerate(names) if name == "message.delta"]
    assert activated_index < min(delta_indices)  # 首个 delta 之前

    activated = next(data for name, data in events if name == "skill.activated")
    assert activated["skill_id"] == skill_id
    assert activated["scope"] == "user"
    assert activated["estimated_tokens"] > 0

    # 技能正文进入模型上下文（system prompt 中的 <skill> 包裹块）
    system_text = str(model.captured[0][0].content)
    assert "<skill" in system_text
    assert "三段式输出" in system_text

    # 停用后显式选择 → 422
    await client.put(f"/api/v1/skills/{skill_id}/enabled", json={"enabled": False}, headers=headers)
    rejected = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/chat/stream", json={"message": "x", "skills": [skill_id]}, headers=headers
    )
    assert rejected.status_code == 422


async def test_read_skill_file_tool(client: httpx.AsyncClient, monkeypatch) -> None:
    """read_skill_file 原生工具读取本轮激活技能的参考文件。"""
    from app.modules.chat import service as chat_service

    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])
    raw = _skill_zip("tool-skill", {"references/checklist.md": b"# 清单\n- 第一项"})
    imported = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/skills/import",
        files={"file": ("tool-skill.zip", io.BytesIO(raw), "application/zip")},
        headers=headers,
    )
    skill = imported.json()

    model = make_scripted_model(
        [
            {
                "tool_calls": [
                    {
                        "name": "read_skill_file",
                        "args": {"skill_id": skill["id"], "path": "references/checklist.md"},
                    }
                ]
            },
            {"text": "清单已读取"},
        ]
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(chat_service, "build_chat_model", lambda settings: model)
    run_id, events = await collect_sse(
        client, headers=headers, payload={"message": "读取技能清单", "skills": [skill["id"]]}
    )
    names = [name for name, _ in events]
    assert "tool.start" in names and "tool.result" in names
    result = next(data for name, data in events if name == "tool.result")
    assert result["status"] == "ok"
    assert result["source"] == "skill"
    assert names[-1] == "message.done"
    assert model.captured[0][0].content  # 第二轮模型能看到工具结果

    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])
    raw = _skill_zip("weekly-notes", {"references/template.md": b"# 模板\n\n- 议题\n- 结论"})

    skill = imported.json()
    assert skill["slug"] == "weekly-notes"

async def test_system_skill_readonly_and_override(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])
    listing = await client.get("/api/v1/skills", headers=headers)
    system_skill = next(item for item in listing.json()["items"] if item["scope"] == "system")
    assert system_skill["slug"] == "weekly-report"

    # 系统技能不可改/删
    assert (
        await client.patch(
            f"/api/v1/skills/{system_skill['id']}", json={"name": "hack"}, headers=headers
        )
    ).status_code == 403
    assert (
        await client.delete(f"/api/v1/skills/{system_skill['id']}", headers=headers)
    ).status_code == 403

    # 停用系统技能 → 写用户覆盖表，effective_enabled=false
    disabled = await client.put(
        f"/api/v1/skills/{system_skill['id']}/enabled", json={"enabled": False}, headers=headers
    )
    assert disabled.status_code == 200
    assert disabled.json()["effective_enabled"] is False

    async with get_session_factory()() as db:
        override = await db.get(
            UserCapabilityOverride, (registered["user"]["id"], "skill", system_skill["id"])
        )
        assert override is not None and override.enabled is False

        # 覆盖只影响本人；重新启用后回到 enabled
    enabled = await client.put(
        f"/api/v1/skills/{system_skill['id']}/enabled", json={"enabled": True}, headers=headers
    )
    assert enabled.json()["effective_enabled"] is True


async def test_skill_cross_user_isolation(client: httpx.AsyncClient, second_client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    alice = await register_user(client)
    bob = await register_user(second_client)
    created = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/skills",
        json={"name": "私有技能", "description": "私有", "content": "内容"},
        headers=auth_headers(alice["access_token"]),
    )
    skill_id = created.json()["id"]
    bob_headers = auth_headers(bob["access_token"])

    assert (
        await second_client.get(f"/api/v1/skills/{skill_id}", headers=bob_headers)
    ).status_code == 404
    assert (
        await second_client.patch(f"/api/v1/skills/{skill_id}", json={"name": "x"}, headers=bob_headers)
    ).status_code == 404
    assert (
        await second_client.delete(f"/api/v1/skills/{skill_id}", headers=bob_headers)
    ).status_code == 404
    own = (await second_client.get("/api/v1/skills", headers=bob_headers)).json()["items"]
    assert all(item["scope"] == "system" for item in own)


async def test_chat_skill_activation_events(client: httpx.AsyncClient, monkeypatch) -> None:
    """聊天携带 skills：skill.activated 在首个 delta 之前，正文进入模型上下文。"""
    from app.modules.chat import service as chat_service

    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])
    created = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/skills",
        json={"name": "周报", "description": "周报生成", "content": "1. 收集进展；2. 三段式输出。"},
        headers=headers,
    )
    skill_id = created.json()["id"]

    model = make_scripted_model([{"text": "按技能输出"}])
    monkeypatch.setattr(chat_service, "build_chat_model", lambda settings: model)
    run_id, events = await collect_sse(
        client, headers=headers, payload={"message": "写周报", "skills": [skill_id]}
    )
    names = [name for name, _ in events]
    assert "skill.activated" in names
    assert names[-1] == "message.done"
    activated_index = names.index("skill.activated")
    delta_indices = [i for i, name in enumerate(names) if name == "message.delta"]
    assert activated_index < min(delta_indices)  # 首个 delta 之前

    activated = next(data for name, data in events if name == "skill.activated")
    assert activated["skill_id"] == skill_id
    assert activated["scope"] == "user"
    assert activated["estimated_tokens"] > 0

    # 技能正文进入模型上下文（system prompt 中的 <skill> 包裹块）
    system_text = str(model.captured[0][0].content)
    assert "<skill" in system_text
    assert "三段式输出" in system_text

    # 停用后显式选择 → 422
    await client.put(f"/api/v1/skills/{skill_id}/enabled", json={"enabled": False}, headers=headers)
    rejected = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/chat/stream", json={"message": "x", "skills": [skill_id]}, headers=headers
    )
    assert rejected.status_code == 422

- After `row.content = ...; await db.commit()`: `updated_at` in dict is **None** (the onupdate=func.now() evaluated... and the attribute became None? Interesting: `onupdate=func.now()` sets updated_at to func.now() — a SQL expression; after commit the attribute holds the expression's result? It shows None).
- Then `db.get` returns same object without refreshing (expire_on_commit=False, so get() doesn't re-SELECT because the object isn't expired!) — but the `updated_at` attribute holds None/expression → accessing it tries to... wait, accessing `row2.updated_at` triggered MissingGreenlet because the attribute holds a SQL expression (func.now()) that must be evaluated? When onupdate is an expression, after flush the attribute is set to the expression result — but here it seems the attribute wasn't populated (None in __dict__ means... it printed "updated_at in dict: False" — so after commit the attribute is no longer in __dict__ at all!).

Hmm — "after commit: None" — `row.__dict__.get("updated_at")` returned None, could mean key absent. So commit DID expire the object despite expire_on_commit=False! Why? Because `row.content = ...` modified it; after UPDATE flush... hmm, expire_on_commit=False should prevent expiry. But wait — maybe the attribute expired due to the UPDATE with onupdate: SQLAlchemy marks columns with onupdate as expired after flush? No...

Actually — I recall: when a column has `onupdate=func.now()`, after the UPDATE, SQLAlchemy expires that attribute because the value is server-generated... no, func.now() is client-side SQL evaluated with RETURNING. Hmm, but psycopg async... 

Whatever the precise mechanism, the robust fix: after commit, explicitly `await db.refresh(skill)` before returning/serializing. That forces a fresh SELECT (within greenlet, awaited) and populates all attributes.

Also my earlier standalone first script DID refresh and worked (second attempt shows "access" worked when refreshed). So the fix: in update_skill, after commit, `await db.refresh(skill)`; then `return await get_skill(...)` — but get_skill's `_load_visible` db.get returns the refreshed object — attributes present → OK.

For `enabled` (plain bool), after commit with expire_on_commit=False, attributes stay. So also refresh there. Actually simplest: refresh in every write-then-read path.
